In thy right hand hold fast thy bolt of thunder, and weaken, Bounteous Lord, his art and magic.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्न शुष्कं वनमिन्द्र हेती रक्षो नि धक्ष्यशनिर्न भीमा ।
गम्भीरय ऋष्वया यो रुरोजाध्वानयद्दुरिता दम्भयच्च ॥
verses.rom:
agnirna shushkam vanamindra heti raksho ni dhakshyashanirna bhima |
gambhiraya rishvaya yo rurojadhvanayaddurita dambhayachcha ||
verses.en:
As Agni, as the dart burns the dry forest, like the dread shaft burn down the fiends, O Indra;
Thou who with high deep-reaching spear hast broken, hast covered over mischief and destroyed it.

verses.sa:
आ सहस्रं पथिभिरिन्द्र राया तुविद्युम्न तुविवाजेभिरर्वाक् ।
याहि सूनो सहसो यस्य नू चिददेव ईशे पुरुहूत योतोः ॥
verses.rom:
a sahasram pathibhirindra raya tuvidyumna tuvivajebhirarvak |
yahi suno sahaso yasya nu chidadeva ishe puruhuta yotoh ||
verses.en:
With wealth, by thousand paths come hither, Agni, paths that bring ample strength, O thou Most Splendid.
Come, Son of Strength, o'er whom, Invoked of many! the godless hath no power to keep thee distant.

verses.sa:
प्र तुविद्युम्नस्य स्थविरस्य घृष्वेर्दिवो ररप्शे महिमा पृथिव्याः ।
नास्य शत्रुर्न प्रतिमानमस्ति न प्रतिष्ठिः पुरुमायस्य सह्योः ॥
verses.rom:
pra tuvidyumnasya sthavirasya ghrishverdivo rarapshe mahima prithivyah |
nasya shatrurna pratimanamasti na pratishthih purumayasya sahyoh ||
verses.en:
From heaven, from earth is bruited forth the greatness of him the firm, the fiery, the resplendent.
No foe hath he, no counterpart, no refuge is there from him the Conqueror full of wisdom

verses.sa:
प्र तत्ते अद्या करणं कृतं भूत्कुत्सं यदायुमतिथिग्वमस्मै ।
पुरू सहस्रा नि शिशा अभि क्षामुत्तूर्वयाणं धृषता निनेथ ॥
verses.rom:
pra tatte adya karanam kritam bhutkutsam yadayumatithigvamasmai |
puru sahasra ni shisha abhi kshamutturvayanam dhrishata ninetha ||
verses.en:
This day the deed that thou hast done is famous, when thou, for him, with many thousand others
Laidest low Kutsa, Ayu, Atithigva, and boldly didst deliver Turvayana.

verses.sa:
अनु त्वाहिघ्ने अध देव देवा मदन्विश्वे कवितमं कवीनाम् ।
करो यत्र वरिवो बाधिताय दिवे जनाय तन्वे गृणानः ॥
verses.rom:
anu tvahighne adha deva deva madanvishve kavitamam kavinam |
karo yatra varivo badhitaya dive janaya tanve grinanah ||
verses.en:
In thee, O God, the wisest of the Sages, all Gods were joyful when thou slewest Ahi.
When lauded for thyself, thou gavest freedom to sore-afflicted Heaven and to the people.

verses.sa:
अनु द्यावापृथिवी तत्त ओजोऽमर्त्या जिहत इन्द्र देवाः ।
कृष्वा कृत्नो अकृतं यत्ते अस्त्युक्थं नवीयो जनयस्व यज्ञैः ॥
verses.rom:
anu dyavaprithivi tatta ojo'martya jihata indra devah |
krishva kritno akritam yatte astyuktham naviyo janayasva yajnaih ||
verses.en:
This power of thine both heaven and earth acknowledge, the deathless Gods acknowledge it, O Indra.
Do what thou ne'er hast done, O Mighty Worker: beget a new hymn at thy sacrifices.

verses.sa:
महाँ इन्द्रो नृवदा चर्षणिप्रा उत द्विबर्हा अमिनः सहोभिः ।
अस्मद्र्यग्वावृधे वीर्यायोरुः पृथुः सुकृतः कर्तृभिर्भूत् ॥
verses.rom:
mahan indro nrivada charshanipra uta dvibarha aminah sahobhih |
asmadryagvavridhe viryayoruh prithuh sukritah kartribhirbhut ||
verses.en:
GREAT, hero-like controlling men is Indra, unwasting in his powers, doubled in vastness.
He, turned to us, hath grown to hero vigour: broad, wide, he hath been decked by those who serve him.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमेव धिषणा सातये धाद्बृहन्तमृष्वमजरं युवानम् ।
अषाळ्हेन शवसा शूशुवांसं सद्यश्चिद्यो वावृधे असामि ॥
verses.rom:
indrameva dhishana sataye dhadbrihantamrishvamajaram yuvanam |
ashalhena shavasa shushuvamsam sadyashchidyo vavridhe asami ||
verses.en:
The bowl made Indra swift to gather booty, the High, the Lofty, Youthful, Undecaying,
Him who hath waxed by strength which none may conquer, and even at once grown to complete perfection.

verses.sa:
पृथू करस्ना बहुला गभस्ती अस्मद्र्यक्सं मिमीहि श्रवांसि ।
यूथेव पश्वः पशुपा दमूना अस्माँ इन्द्राभ्या ववृत्स्वाजौ ॥
verses.rom:
prithu karasna bahula gabhasti asmadryaksam mimihi shravamsi |
yutheva pashvah pashupa damuna asman indrabhya vavritsvajau ||
verses.en:
Stretch out those hands of thine, extend to us-ward thy wide capacious arms, and grant us glory.
Like as the household herdsman guards the cattle, so move thou round about us in the combat.

verses.sa:
तं व इन्द्रं चतिनमस्य शाकैरिह नूनं वाजयन्तो हुवेम ।
यथा चित्पूर्वे जरितार आसुरनेद्या अनवद्या अरिष्टाः ॥
verses.rom:
tam va indram chatinamasya shakairiha nunam vajayanto huvema |
yatha chitpurve jaritara asuranedya anavadya arishtah ||
verses.en:
Now, fain for strength, let us invite your Indra hither, who lieth hidden with his Heroes,-
Free from all blame, without reproach, uninjured, e'en as were those who sang, of old, his praises.

verses.sa:
धृतव्रतो धनदाः सोमवृद्धः स हि वामस्य वसुनः पुरुक्षुः ।
सं जग्मिरे पथ्या रायो अस्मिन्त्समुद्रे न सिन्धवो यादमानाः ॥
verses.rom:
dhritavrato dhanadah somavriddhah sa hi vamasya vasunah purukshuh |
sam jagmire pathya rayo asmintsamudre na sindhavo yadamanah ||
verses.en:
With steadfast laws, wealth-giver, strong through Soma, he hath much fair and precious food to feed us.
In him unite all paths that lead to riches, like rivers that commingle with the ocean.

verses.sa:
शविष्ठं न आ भर शूर शव ओजिष्ठमोजो अभिभूत उग्रम् ।
विश्वा द्युम्ना वृष्ण्या मानुषाणामस्मभ्यं दा हरिवो मादयध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
shavishtham na a bhara shura shava ojishthamojo abhibhuta ugram |
vishva dyumna vrishnya manushanamasmabhyam da harivo madayadhyai ||
verses.en:
Bring unto us the mightiest might, O Hero, strong and most potent force, thou great Subduer!
All splendid vigorous powers of men vouchsafe us, Lord of Bay Steeds, that they may make us joyful.

verses.sa:
यस्ते मदः पृतनाषाळमृध्र इन्द्र तं न आ भर शूशुवांसम् ।
येन तोकस्य तनयस्य सातौ मंसीमहि जिगीवांसस्त्वोताः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste madah pritanashalamridhra indra tam na a bhara shushuvamsam |
yena tokasya tanayasya satau mamsimahi jigivamsastvotah ||
verses.en:
Bring us, grown mighty in its strength, O Indra, thy friendly rapturous joy that wins the battle,
Wherewith by thee assisted and triumphant, we may laud thee in gaining seed and offspring.

verses.sa:
आ नो भर वृषणं शुष्ममिन्द्र धनस्पृतं शूशुवांसं सुदक्षम् ।
येन वंसाम पृतनासु शत्रून्तवोतिभिरुत जामीँरजामीन् ॥
verses.rom:
a no bhara vrishanam shushmamindra dhanaspritam shushuvamsam sudaksham |
yena vamsama pritanasu shatruntavotibhiruta jaminrajamin ||
verses.en:
Indra, bestow on us the power heroic skilled and exceeding strong, that wins the booty,
Wherewith, by thine assistance, we may conquer our foes in battle, be they kin or stranger.

verses.sa:
आ ते शुष्मो वृषभ एतु पश्चादोत्तरादधरादा पुरस्तात् ।
आ विश्वतो अभि समेत्वर्वाङिन्द्र द्युम्नं स्वर्वद्धेह्यस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
a te shushmo vrishabha etu pashchadottaradadharada purastat |
a vishvato abhi sametvarvanindra dyumnam svarvaddhehyasme ||
verses.en:
Let thine heroic strength come from behind us, before us, from above us or below us.
From every side may it approach us, Indra. Give us the glory of the realm of splendour.

verses.sa:
नृवत्त इन्द्र नृतमाभिरूती वंसीमहि वामं श्रोमतेभिः ।
ईक्षे हि वस्व उभयस्य राजन्धा रत्नं महि स्थूरं बृहन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
nrivatta indra nritamabhiruti vamsimahi vamam shromatebhih |
ikshe hi vasva ubhayasya rajandha ratnam mahi sthuram brihantam ||
verses.en:
With most heroic aid from thee, like heroes Indra, may we win wealth by deeds glory.
Thou, King, art Lord of earthly, heavenly treasure: vouchsafe us riches vast, sublime, and lasting.

verses.sa:
मरुत्वन्तं वृषभं वावृधानमकवारिं दिव्यं शासमिन्द्रम् ।
विश्वासाहमवसे नूतनायोग्रं सहोदामिह तं हुवेम ॥
verses.rom:
marutvantam vrishabham vavridhanamakavarim divyam shasamindram |
vishvasahamavase nutanayogram sahodamiha tam huvema ||
verses.en:
The Bull, whose strength hath waxed, whom Maruts follow, free-giving Indra, the Celestial Ruler,
Mighty, all-conquering, the victory-giver, him let us call to grant us new protection.

verses.sa:
जनं वज्रिन्महि चिन्मन्यमानमेभ्यो नृभ्यो रन्धया येष्वस्मि ।
अधा हि त्वा पृथिव्यां शूरसातौ हवामहे तनये गोष्वप्सु ॥
verses.rom:
janam vajrinmahi chinmanyamanamebhyo nribhyo randhaya yeshvasmi |
adha hi tva prithivyam shurasatau havamahe tanaye goshvapsu ||
verses.en:
Give up the people who are high and haughty to these men and to me, O Thunder-wielder!
Therefore upon the earth do we invoke thee, where heroes win, for sons and kine and waters.

verses.sa:
वयं त एभिः पुरुहूत सख्यैः शत्रोःशत्रोरुत्तर इत्स्याम ।
घ्नन्तो वृत्राण्युभयानि शूर राया मदेम बृहता त्वोताः ॥
verses.rom:
vayam ta ebhih puruhuta sakhyaih shatrohshatroruttara itsyama |
ghnanto vritranyubhayani shura raya madema brihata tvotah ||
verses.en:
Through these thy friendships, God invoked of many! may we be victors over every foeman.
Slaying both kinds of foe, may we, O Hero, be happy, helped by thee, with ample riches.

verses.sa:
द्यौर्न य इन्द्राभि भूमार्यस्तस्थौ रयिः शवसा पृत्सु जनान् ।
तं नः सहस्रभरमुर्वरासां दद्धि सूनो सहसो वृत्रतुरम् ॥
verses.rom:
dyaurna ya indrabhi bhumaryastasthau rayih shavasa pritsu janan |
tam nah sahasrabharamurvarasam daddhi suno sahaso vritraturam ||
verses.en:
GIVE us wealth, Indra, that with might, as heaven o'ertops the earth, o'ercomes our foes in battle
Wealth that brings thousands and that wins the corn-lands, wealth, Son of Strength! that vanquishes the foeman.

verses.sa:
दिवो न तुभ्यमन्विन्द्र सत्रासुर्यं देवेभिर्धायि विश्वम् ।
अहिं यद्वृत्रमपो वव्रिवांसं हन्नृजीषिन्विष्णुना सचानः ॥
verses.rom:
divo na tubhyamanvindra satrasuryam devebhirdhayi vishvam |
ahim yadvritramapo vavrivamsam hannrijishinvishnuna sachanah ||
verses.en:
Even as the power of Dyaus, to thee, O Indra, all Asura sway was by the Gods entrusted,
When thou, Impetuous! leagued with Visnu, slewest Vrtra the Dragon who enclosed the waters.

verses.sa:
तूर्वन्नोजीयान्तवसस्तवीयान्कृतब्रह्मेन्द्रो वृद्धमहाः ।
राजाभवन्मधुनः सोम्यस्य विश्वासां यत्पुरां दर्त्नुमावत् ॥
verses.rom:
turvannojiyantavasastaviyankritabrahmendro vriddhamahah |
rajabhavanmadhunah somyasya vishvasam yatpuram dartnumavat ||
verses.en:
Indra, Strong, Victor, Mightier than the mighty, addressed with prayer and perfect in his splendour,
Lord of the bolt that breaketh forts in pieces, became the King of the sweet juice of Soma..

verses.sa:
शतैरपद्रन्पणय इन्द्रात्र दशोणये कवयेऽर्कसातौ ।
वधैः शुष्णस्याशुषस्य मायाः पित्वो नारिरेचीत्किं चन प्र ॥
verses.rom:
shatairapadranpanaya indratra dashonaye kavaye'rkasatau |
vadhaih shushnasyashushasya mayah pitvo narirechitkim chana pra ||
verses.en:
There, Indra, while the light was won, the Panis f1ed, 'neath a hundred blows, for wise Dasoni,
And greedy Susna's magical devices nor left he any of their food remaining.

verses.sa:
महो द्रुहो अप विश्वायु धायि वज्रस्य यत्पतने पादि शुष्णः ।
उरु ष सरथं सारथये करिन्द्रः कुत्साय सूर्यस्य सातौ ॥
verses.rom:
maho druho apa vishvayu dhayi vajrasya yatpatane padi shushnah |
uru sha saratham sarathaye karindrah kutsaya suryasya satau ||
verses.en:
What time the thunder fell and Susna perished, all life's support from the great Druh was taken.
Indra made room for his car-drivcr Kutsa who sate beside him, when he gained the sunlight.

verses.sa:
प्र श्येनो न मदिरमंशुमस्मै शिरो दासस्य नमुचेर्मथायन् ।
प्रावन्नमीं साप्यं ससन्तं पृणग्राया समिषा सं स्वस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
pra shyeno na madiramamshumasmai shiro dasasya namuchermathayan |
pravannamim sapyam sasantam prinagraya samisha sam svasti ||
verses.en:
As the Hawk rent for him the stalk that gladdens, he wrenched the head from Namuci the Dasa.
He guarded Nam, Sayya's son, in slumber, and sated him with food, success, and riches.

verses.sa:
वि पिप्रोरहिमायस्य दृळ्हाः पुरो वज्रिञ्छवसा न दर्दः ।
सुदामन्तद्रेक्णो अप्रमृष्यमृजिश्वने दात्रं दाशुषे दाः ॥
verses.rom:
vi piprorahimayasya drilhah puro vajrinchhavasa na dardah |
sudamantadrekno apramrishyamrijishvane datram dashushe dah ||
verses.en:
Thou, thunder-armed, with thy great might hast shattered Pipru's strong forts who knew the wiles of serpents.
Thou gavest to thy worshipper Rjisvan imperishable Wealth, O Bounteous Giver.

verses.sa:
स वेतसुं दशमायं दशोणिं तूतुजिमिन्द्रः स्वभिष्टिसुम्नः ।
आ तुग्रं शश्वदिभं द्योतनाय मातुर्न सीमुप सृजा इयध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
sa vetasum dashamayam dashonim tutujimindrah svabhishtisumnah |
a tugram shashvadibham dyotanaya maturna simupa srija iyadhyai ||
verses.en:
The crafty Vetasu, the swift Dasni, and Tugra speedily with all his servants,
Hath Indra, gladdening with strong assistance, forced near as 'twere to glorify the Mother.

verses.sa:
स ईं स्पृधो वनते अप्रतीतो बिभ्रद्वज्रं वृत्रहणं गभस्तौ ।
तिष्ठद्धरी अध्यस्तेव गर्ते वचोयुजा वहत इन्द्रमृष्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa im spridho vanate apratito bibhradvajram vritrahanam gabhastau |
tishthaddhari adhyasteva garte vachoyuja vahata indramrishvam ||
verses.en:
Resistless, with the hosts he battles, bearing in both his arms the Vrtra-slaying thunder.
He mounts his Bays, as the car-seat an archer: yoked at a word they bear the lofty Indra.

verses.sa:
सनेम तेऽवसा नव्य इन्द्र प्र पूरव स्तवन्त एना यज्ञैः ।
सप्त यत्पुरः शर्म शारदीर्दर्द्धन्दासीः पुरुकुत्साय शिक्षन् ॥
verses.rom:
sanema te'vasa navya indra pra purava stavanta ena yajnaih |
sapta yatpurah sharma sharadirdarddhandasih purukutsaya shikshan ||
verses.en:
May we, O Indra, gain by thy new favour: so Parus laud thee, with their sacrifices,
That thou hast wrecked seven autumn forts, their shelter, slain Dasa tribes and aided Purukutsa.

verses.sa:
त्वं वृध इन्द्र पूर्व्यो भूर्वरिवस्यन्नुशने काव्याय ।
परा नववास्त्वमनुदेयं महे पित्रे ददाथ स्वं नपातम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vridha indra purvyo bhurvarivasyannushane kavyaya |
para navavastvamanudeyam mahe pitre dadatha svam napatam ||
verses.en:
Favouring Usana the son of Kavi, thou wast his ancient strengthener, O Indra.
Thou gavest Navavastva. as a present, to the great father gavest back his grandson.

verses.sa:
त्वं धुनिरिन्द्र धुनिमतीरृणोरपः सीरा न स्रवन्तीः ।
प्र यत्समुद्रमति शूर पर्षि पारया तुर्वशं यदुं स्वस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
tvam dhunirindra dhunimatirrinorapah sira na sravantih |
pra yatsamudramati shura parshi paraya turvasham yadum svasti ||
verses.en:
Thou, roaring Indra, drovest on the waters that made a roaring sound like rushing rivers,
What time, O Hero, o'er the sea thou broughtest, in safety broughtest Turvasa and Yadu.

verses.sa:
तव ह त्यदिन्द्र विश्वमाजौ सस्तो धुनीचुमुरी या ह सिष्वप् ।
दीदयदित्तुभ्यं सोमेभिः सुन्वन्दभीतिरिध्मभृतिः पक्थ्यर्कैः ॥
verses.rom:
tava ha tyadindra vishvamajau sasto dhunichumuri ya ha sishvap |
didayadittubhyam somebhih sunvandabhitiridhmabhritih pakthyarkaih ||
verses.en:
This Indra, was thy work in war: thou sentest Dhuni and Cumuri to sleep and slumber.
Dabhiti lit the flame for thee, and worshipped with fuel, hymns, poured Soma, dressed oblations.

verses.sa:
इमा उ त्वा पुरुतमस्य कारोर्हव्यं वीर हव्या हवन्ते ।
धियो रथेष्ठामजरं नवीयो रयिर्विभूतिरीयते वचस्या ॥
verses.rom:
ima u tva purutamasya karorhavyam vira havya havante |
dhiyo ratheshthamajaram naviyo rayirvibhutiriyate vachasya ||
verses.en:
THESE the most constant singer's invocations call thee who art to be invoked, O Hero;
Hymns call anew the chariot-borne, Eternal: by eloquence men gain abundant riches.

verses.sa:
तमु स्तुष इन्द्रं यो विदानो गिर्वाहसं गीर्भिर्यज्ञवृद्धम् ।
यस्य दिवमति मह्ना पृथिव्याः पुरुमायस्य रिरिचे महित्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamu stusha indram yo vidano girvahasam girbhiryajnavriddham |
yasya divamati mahna prithivyah purumayasya ririche mahitvam ||
verses.en:
I praise that Indra, known to all men, honoured with songs, extolled with hymns at sacrifices,
Whose majesty, rich in wondrous arts, surpasseth the magnitude of earth, and heaven in greatness.

verses.sa:
स इत्तमोऽवयुनं ततन्वत्सूर्येण वयुनवच्चकार ।
कदा ते मर्ता अमृतस्य धामेयक्षन्तो न मिनन्ति स्वधावः ॥
verses.rom:
sa ittamo'vayunam tatanvatsuryena vayunavachchakara |
kada te marta amritasya dhameyakshanto na minanti svadhavah ||
verses.en:
He hath made pathways, with the Sun to aid him, throughout the darkness that extended pathless.
Mortals who yearn to worship ne'er dishonour, O Mighty God, thy Law who art Immortal.

verses.sa:
यस्ता चकार स कुह स्विदिन्द्रः कमा जनं चरति कासु विक्षु ।
कस्ते यज्ञो मनसे शं वराय को अर्क इन्द्र कतमः स होता ॥
verses.rom:
yasta chakara sa kuha svidindrah kama janam charati kasu vikshu |
kaste yajno manase sham varaya ko arka indra katamah sa hota ||
verses.en:
And he who did these things, where is that Indra? among what tribes? what people doth he visit?
What sacrifice contents thy mind , and wishes? What priest among them all? what hymn, O Indra?

verses.sa:
इदा हि ते वेविषतः पुराजाः प्रत्नास आसुः पुरुकृत्सखायः ।
ये मध्यमास उत नूतनास उतावमस्य पुरुहूत बोधि ॥
verses.rom:
ida hi te vevishatah purajah pratnasa asuh purukritsakhayah |
ye madhyamasa uta nutanasa utavamasya puruhuta bodhi ||
verses.en:
Yea, here were they who, born of old, have served thee, thy friends of ancient time, thou active Worker.
Bethink thee now of these, Invoked of many! the midmost and the recent, and the youngest.

verses.sa:
तं पृच्छन्तोऽवरासः पराणि प्रत्ना त इन्द्र श्रुत्यानु येमुः ।
अर्चामसि वीर ब्रह्मवाहो यादेव विद्म तात्त्वा महान्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam prichchhanto'varasah parani pratna ta indra shrutyanu yemuh |
archamasi vira brahmavaho yadeva vidma tattva mahantam ||
verses.en:
Inquiring after him, thy later servants, Indra, have gained thy former old traditions.
Hero, to whom the prayer is brought, we praise thee as great for that wherein we know thee mighty.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा पाजो रक्षसो वि तस्थे महि जज्ञानमभि तत्सु तिष्ठ ।
तव प्रत्नेन युज्येन सख्या वज्रेण धृष्णो अप ता नुदस्व ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva pajo rakshaso vi tasthe mahi jajnanamabhi tatsu tishtha |
tava pratnena yujyena sakhya vajrena dhrishno apa ta nudasva ||
verses.en:
The demon's strength is gathered fast against thee: great as that strength hath grown, go forth to meet it.
With thine own ancient friend and companion, the thunderbolt, brave Champion! drive it backward.

verses.sa:
स तु श्रुधीन्द्र नूतनस्य ब्रह्मण्यतो वीर कारुधायः ।
त्वं ह्यापिः प्रदिवि पितॄणां शश्वद्बभूथ सुहव एष्टौ ॥
verses.rom:
sa tu shrudhindra nutanasya brahmanyato vira karudhayah |
tvam hyapih pradivi pitrinam shashvadbabhutha suhava eshtau ||
verses.en:
Hear, too, the prayer of this thy present beadsman, O Indra, Hero, cherishing the singer.
For thou wast aye our fathers' Friend aforetime, still swift to listen to their supplication.

verses.sa:
प्रोतये वरुणं मित्रमिन्द्रं मरुतः कृष्वावसे नो अद्य ।
प्र पूषणं विष्णुमग्निं पुरंधिं सवितारमोषधीः पर्वताँश्च ॥
verses.rom:
protaye varunam mitramindram marutah krishvavase no adya |
pra pushanam vishnumagnim puramdhim savitaramoshadhih parvatanshcha ||
verses.en:
Bring to our help this day, for our protection, Varuna, Mitra , Indra, and the Maruts,
Pusan and Visnu, Agni and Purandhi, Savitar also, and the Plants and Mountains.

verses.sa:
इम उ त्वा पुरुशाक प्रयज्यो जरितारो अभ्यर्चन्त्यर्कैः ।
श्रुधी हवमा हुवतो हुवानो न त्वावाँ अन्यो अमृत त्वदस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
ima u tva purushaka prayajyo jaritaro abhyarchantyarkaih |
shrudhi havama huvato huvano na tvavan anyo amrita tvadasti ||
verses.en:
The singers here exalt with hymns and praises thee who art very Mighty and Most Holy.
Hear, when invoked, the invoker's invocation. Beside thee there is nonelike thee, Immortal!

verses.sa:
नू म आ वाचमुप याहि विद्वान्विश्वेभिः सूनो सहसो यजत्रैः ।
ये अग्निजिह्वा ऋतसाप आसुर्ये मनुं चक्रुरुपरं दसाय ॥
verses.rom:
nu ma a vachamupa yahi vidvanvishvebhih suno sahaso yajatraih |
ye agnijihva ritasapa asurye manum chakruruparam dasaya ||
verses.en:
Now to my words come quickly thou who knowest, O Son of Strength, with all who claim our worship,
Who visit sacred rites, whose tongue is Agni, Gods who made Manu stronger than the Dasyu.

verses.sa:
स नो बोधि पुरएता सुगेषूत दुर्गेषु पथिकृद्विदानः ।
ये अश्रमास उरवो वहिष्ठास्तेभिर्न इन्द्राभि वक्षि वाजम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa no bodhi puraeta sugeshuta durgeshu pathikridvidanah |
ye ashramasa uravo vahishthastebhirna indrabhi vakshi vajam ||
verses.en:
On good and evil ways be thou our Leader, thou who art known to all as Path-preparer.
Bring power to us, O Indra, with thy Horses, Steeds that are best to draw, broad-backed, unwearied.

verses.sa:
य एक इद्धव्यश्चर्षणीनामिन्द्रं तं गीर्भिरभ्यर्च आभिः ।
यः पत्यते वृषभो वृष्ण्यावान्सत्यः सत्वा पुरुमायः सहस्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
ya eka iddhavyashcharshaninamindram tam girbhirabhyarcha abhih |
yah patyate vrishabho vrishnyavansatyah satva purumayah sahasvan ||
verses.en:
WITH these my hymns I glorify that Indra who is alone to be invoked by mortals,
The Lord, the Mighty One, of manly vigour, victorious, Hero, true, and full of wisdom.

verses.sa:
तमु नः पूर्वे पितरो नवग्वाः सप्त विप्रासो अभि वाजयन्तः ।
नक्षद्दाभं ततुरिं पर्वतेष्ठामद्रोघवाचं मतिभिः शविष्ठम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamu nah purve pitaro navagvah sapta vipraso abhi vajayantah |
nakshaddabham taturim parvateshthamadroghavacham matibhih shavishtham ||
verses.en:
Our sires of old,. Navagvas, sages seven, while urging him to show his might, extolled him,
Dwelling on heights, swift, smiting down opponents, guileless in word, and in his thoughts most mighty.

verses.sa:
तमीमह इन्द्रमस्य रायः पुरुवीरस्य नृवतः पुरुक्षोः ।
यो अस्कृधोयुरजरः स्वर्वान्तमा भर हरिवो मादयध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
tamimaha indramasya rayah puruvirasya nrivatah purukshoh |
yo askridhoyurajarah svarvantama bhara harivo madayadhyai ||
verses.en:
We seek that Indra to obtain his riches that bring much food, and men, and store of heroes.
Bring us, Lord of Bay Steeds, to make us joyful, celestial wealth, abundant, undecaying.

verses.sa:
तन्नो वि वोचो यदि ते पुरा चिज्जरितार आनशुः सुम्नमिन्द्र ।
कस्ते भागः किं वयो दुध्र खिद्वः पुरुहूत पुरूवसोऽसुरघ्नः ॥
verses.rom:
tanno vi vocho yadi te pura chijjaritara anashuh sumnamindra |
kaste bhagah kim vayo dudhra khidvah puruhuta puruvaso'suraghnah ||
verses.en:
Tell thou us this, if at thy hand aforetime the earlier singers have obtained good fortune,
What is thy share and portion, Strong Subduer, Asura-slayer, rich, invoked of many?

verses.sa:
तं पृच्छन्ती वज्रहस्तं रथेष्ठामिन्द्रं वेपी वक्वरी यस्य नू गीः ।
तुविग्राभं तुविकूर्मिं रभोदां गातुमिषे नक्षते तुम्रमच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
tam prichchhanti vajrahastam ratheshthamindram vepi vakvari yasya nu gih |
tuvigrabham tuvikurmim rabhodam gatumishe nakshate tumramachchha ||
verses.en:
He who for car-borne Indra, armed with thunder, hath a hymn, craving, deeply-piercing, fluent,
Who sends a song effectual, firmly-grasping, and strength-bestowing, he comes near the mighty.

verses.sa:
अया ह त्यं मायया वावृधानं मनोजुवा स्वतवः पर्वतेन ।
अच्युता चिद्वीळिता स्वोजो रुजो वि दृळ्हा धृषता विरप्शिन् ॥
verses.rom:
aya ha tyam mayaya vavridhanam manojuva svatavah parvatena |
achyuta chidvilita svojo rujo vi drilha dhrishata virapshin ||
verses.en:
Strong of thyself, thou by this art hast shattered, with thought-swift Parvata, him who waxed against thee,
And, Mightiest! roaring! boldly rent in pieces things that were firmly fixed and never shaken.

verses.sa:
तं वो धिया नव्यस्या शविष्ठं प्रत्नं प्रत्नवत्परितंसयध्यै ।
स नो वक्षदनिमानः सुवह्मेन्द्रो विश्वान्यति दुर्गहाणि ॥
verses.rom:
tam vo dhiya navyasya shavishtham pratnam pratnavatparitamsayadhyai |
sa no vakshadanimanah suvahmendro vishvanyati durgahani ||
verses.en:
Him will we fit for you with new devotion, the strongest Ancient One, in ancient manner.
So may that Indra, boundless, faithful Leader, conduct us o'er all places hard to traverse.

verses.sa:
आ जनाय द्रुह्वणे पार्थिवानि दिव्यानि दीपयोऽन्तरिक्षा ।
तपा वृषन्विश्वतः शोचिषा तान्ब्रह्मद्विषे शोचय क्षामपश्च ॥
verses.rom:
a janaya druhvane parthivani divyani dipayo'ntariksha |
tapa vrishanvishvatah shochisha tanbrahmadvishe shochaya kshamapashcha ||
verses.en:
Thou for the people who oppress hast kindled the earthly firmament and that of heaven.
With heat, O Bull, on every side consume them: heat earth and flood for him who hates devotion.

verses.sa:
भुवो जनस्य दिव्यस्य राजा पार्थिवस्य जगतस्त्वेषसंदृक् ।
धिष्व वज्रं दक्षिण इन्द्र हस्ते विश्वा अजुर्य दयसे वि मायाः ॥
verses.rom:
bhuvo janasya divyasya raja parthivasya jagatastveshasamdrik |
dhishva vajram dakshina indra haste vishva ajurya dayase vi mayah ||
verses.en:
Of all the Heavenly Folk, of earthly creatures thou art the King, O God of splendid aspect.
In thy right hand, O Indra, grasp die thunder: Eternal! thou destroyest all enchantments.

verses.sa:
आ संयतमिन्द्र णः स्वस्तिं शत्रुतूर्याय बृहतीममृध्राम् ।
यया दासान्यार्याणि वृत्रा करो वज्रिन्सुतुका नाहुषाणि ॥
verses.rom:
a samyatamindra nah svastim shatruturyaya brihatimamridhram |
yaya dasanyaryani vritra karo vajrinsutuka nahushani ||
verses.en:
Give us confirmed prosperity, O Indra, vast and exhaustless for the foe's subduing.
Strengthen therewith the Arya's hate and Dasa's, and let the arms of Nahusas be mighty.

verses.sa:
स नो नियुद्भिः पुरुहूत वेधो विश्ववाराभिरा गहि प्रयज्यो ।
न या अदेवो वरते न देव आभिर्याहि तूयमा मद्र्यद्रिक् ॥
verses.rom:
sa no niyudbhih puruhuta vedho vishvavarabhira gahi prayajyo |
na ya adevo varate na deva abhiryahi tuyama madryadrik ||
verses.en:
Come with thy team which brings all blessings hither, Disposer, much-invoked, exceeding holy.
Thou whom no fiend, no God can stay or hinder, come swittly with these Steeds in my direction.

verses.sa:
सुत इत्त्वं निमिश्ल इन्द्र सोमे स्तोमे ब्रह्मणि शस्यमान उक्थे ।
यद्वा युक्ताभ्यां मघवन्हरिभ्यां बिभ्रद्वज्रं बाह्वोरिन्द्र यासि ॥
verses.rom:
suta ittvam nimishla indra some stome brahmani shasyamana ukthe |
yadva yuktabhyam maghavanharibhyam bibhradvajram bahvorindra yasi ||
verses.en:
THOU art attached to pressed-out Soma, Indra, at laud, at prayer, and when the hymn is chanted;
Or when with yoked Bays, Maghavan, thou comest, O Indra, bearing in thine arms the thunder.

verses.sa:
यद्वा दिवि पार्ये सुष्विमिन्द्र वृत्रहत्येऽवसि शूरसातौ ।
यद्वा दक्षस्य बिभ्युषो अबिभ्यदरन्धयः शर्धत इन्द्र दस्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
yadva divi parye sushvimindra vritrahatye'vasi shurasatau |
yadva dakshasya bibhyusho abibhyadarandhayah shardhata indra dasyun ||
verses.en:
Or when on that decisive day thou holpest the presser of the juice at Vrtra's slaughter;
Or when thou, while the strong one feared, undaunted, gavest to death, Indra, the daring Dasyus.

verses.sa:
पाता सुतमिन्द्रो अस्तु सोमं प्रणेनीरुग्रो जरितारमूती ।
कर्ता वीराय सुष्वय उ लोकं दाता वसु स्तुवते कीरये चित् ॥
verses.rom:
pata sutamindro astu somam pranenirugro jaritaramuti |
karta viraya sushvaya u lokam data vasu stuvate kiraye chit ||
verses.en:
Let Indra drink the pressed-out Soma, Helper and mighty Guide of him who sings his praises.
He gives the hero room who pours oblations, and treasure even to the lowly singer.

verses.sa:
गन्तेयान्ति सवना हरिभ्यां बभ्रिर्वज्रं पपिः सोमं ददिर्गाः ।
कर्ता वीरं नर्यं सर्ववीरं श्रोता हवं गृणत स्तोमवाहाः ॥
verses.rom:
ganteyanti savana haribhyam babhrirvajram papih somam dadirgah |
karta viram naryam sarvaviram shrota havam grinata stomavahah ||
verses.en:
E'en humble rites with his Bay steeds he visits: he wields the bolt, drinks Soma, gives us cattle.
He makes the valiant rich in store of heroes, accepts our praise and hears the singer's calling.

verses.sa:
अस्मै वयं यद्वावान तद्विविष्म इन्द्राय यो नः प्रदिवो अपस्कः ।
सुते सोमे स्तुमसि शंसदुक्थेन्द्राय ब्रह्म वर्धनं यथासत् ॥
verses.rom:
asmai vayam yadvavana tadvivishma indraya yo nah pradivo apaskah |
sute some stumasi shamsadukthendraya brahma vardhanam yathasat ||
verses.en:
What he hath longed for we have brought to Indra, who from the days of old hath done us service.
While Soma flows we will sing hymn, and laud him, so that our prayer may streng. then Indra's vigour.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्माणि हि चकृषे वर्धनानि तावत्त इन्द्र मतिभिर्विविष्मः ।
सुते सोमे सुतपाः शंतमानि राण्ड्या क्रियास्म वक्षणानि यज्ञैः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmani hi chakrishe vardhanani tavatta indra matibhirvivishmah |
sute some sutapah shamtamani randya kriyasma vakshanani yajnaih ||
verses.en:
Thou hast made prayer the means of thine exalting, therefore we wait on thee with hymns, O Indra.
May we, by the pressed Soma, Somadrinker! bring thee, with sacrifice, blissful sweet refreshment.

verses.sa:
स नो बोधि पुरोळाशं रराणः पिबा तु सोमं गोऋजीकमिन्द्र ।
एदं बर्हिर्यजमानस्य सीदोरुं कृधि त्वायत उ लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa no bodhi purolasham raranah piba tu somam gorijikamindra |
edam barhiryajamanasya sidorum kridhi tvayata u lokam ||
verses.en:
Mark well our sacrificial cake, delighted Indra, drink Soma and the milk commingled.
Here on the sacrificer's grass be seated: give ample room to thy devoted servant.

verses.sa:
स मन्दस्वा ह्यनु जोषमुग्र प्र त्वा यज्ञास इमे अश्नुवन्तु ।
प्रेमे हवासः पुरुहूतमस्मे आ त्वेयं धीरवस इन्द्र यम्याः ॥
verses.rom:
sa mandasva hyanu joshamugra pra tva yajnasa ime ashnuvantu |
preme havasah puruhutamasme a tveyam dhiravasa indra yamyah ||
verses.en:
O Mighty One, be joyful as thou willest. Let these our sacrifices reach and find thee;
And may this hymn and these our invocations turn thee, whom many men invoke, to help us.

verses.sa:
तं वः सखायः सं यथा सुतेषु सोमेभिरीं पृणता भोजमिन्द्रम् ।
कुवित्तस्मा असति नो भराय न सुष्विमिन्द्रोऽवसे मृधाति ॥
verses.rom:
tam vah sakhayah sam yatha suteshu somebhirim prinata bhojamindram |
kuvittasma asati no bharaya na sushvimindro'vase mridhati ||
verses.en:
Friends, when thejuices flow, replenish duly your own, your bounteous Indra with the Soma.
Will it not aid him to support us? Indra. spares him who sheds the juice to win his favour.

verses.sa:
एवेदिन्द्रः सुते अस्तावि सोमे भरद्वाजेषु क्षयदिन्मघोनः ।
असद्यथा जरित्र उत सूरिरिन्द्रो रायो विश्ववारस्य दाता ॥
verses.rom:
evedindrah sute astavi some bharadvajeshu kshayadinmaghonah |
asadyatha jaritra uta suririndro rayo vishvavarasya data ||
verses.en:
While Soma flowed, thus Indra hath been lauded, Ruler of nobles, mid the Bharadvajas,
That Indra may become the singer's patron and give him wealth in every kind of treasure.

verses.sa:
वृषा मद इन्द्रे श्लोक उक्था सचा सोमेषु सुतपा ऋजीषी ।
अर्चत्र्यो मघवा नृभ्य उक्थैर्द्युक्षो राजा गिरामक्षितोतिः ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha mada indre shloka uktha sacha someshu sutapa rijishi |
archatryo maghava nribhya ukthairdyuksho raja giramakshitotih ||
verses.en:
STRONG rapturous joy, praise, glory are with Indra: impetuous God, he quaffs the juice of Soma:
That Maghavan whom men must laud with singing, Heaven-dweller, King of songs, whose help is lasting.

verses.sa:
ततुरिर्वीरो नर्यो विचेताः श्रोता हवं गृणत उर्व्यूतिः ।
वसुः शंसो नरां कारुधाया वाजी स्तुतो विदथे दाति वाजम् ॥
verses.rom:
taturirviro naryo vichetah shrota havam grinata urvyutih |
vasuh shamso naram karudhaya vaji stuto vidathe dati vajam ||
verses.en:
He, Friend of man, most wise, victorious Hero, hears, with far-reaching aid, the singer call him.
Excellent, Praise of Men, the bard's Supporter, Strong, he gives strength, extolled in holy synod.

verses.sa:
अक्षो न चक्र्योः शूर बृहन्प्र ते मह्ना रिरिचे रोदस्योः ।
वृक्षस्य नु ते पुरुहूत वया व्यूतयो रुरुहुरिन्द्र पूर्वीः ॥
verses.rom:
aksho na chakryoh shura brihanpra te mahna ririche rodasyoh |
vrikshasya nu te puruhuta vaya vyutayo ruruhurindra purvih ||
verses.en:
The lofty axle of thy wheels, O Hero, is not surpassed by heaven and earth in greatness.
Like branches of a tree, Invoked of many manifold aids spring forth from thee, O Indra.

verses.sa:
शचीवतस्ते पुरुशाक शाका गवामिव स्रुतयः संचरणीः ।
वत्सानां न तन्तयस्त इन्द्र दामन्वन्तो अदामानः सुदामन् ॥
verses.rom:
shachivataste purushaka shaka gavamiva srutayah samcharanih |
vatsanam na tantayasta indra damanvanto adamanah sudaman ||
verses.en:
Strong Lord, thine energies, endowed with vigour, are like the paths of kine converging homeward.
Like bonds of cord, Indra, that bind the younglings, no bonds are they, O thou of boundless bounty.

verses.sa:
अन्यदद्य कर्वरमन्यदु श्वोऽसच्च सन्मुहुराचक्रिरिन्द्रः ।
मित्रो नो अत्र वरुणश्च पूषार्यो वशस्य पर्येतास्ति ॥
verses.rom:
anyadadya karvaramanyadu shvo'sachcha sanmuhurachakririndrah |
mitro no atra varunashcha pusharyo vashasya paryetasti ||
verses.en:
One act to-day, another act tomorrow oft Indra makes what is not yet existent.
Here have we Mitra, Varuna, and Pusan to overcome the foeman's domination.

verses.sa:
वि त्वदापो न पर्वतस्य पृष्ठादुक्थेभिरिन्द्रानयन्त यज्ञैः ।
तं त्वाभिः सुष्टुतिभिर्वाजयन्त आजिं न जग्मुर्गिर्वाहो अश्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
vi tvadapo na parvatasya prishthadukthebhirindranayanta yajnaih |
tam tvabhih sushtutibhirvajayanta ajim na jagmurgirvaho ashvah ||
verses.en:
By song and sacrifice men brought the waters from thee, as from a mountain's ridge, O Indra.
Urging thy might, with these fair lauds they seek thee, O theme of song, as horses rush tobattle.

verses.sa:
न यं जरन्ति शरदो न मासा न द्याव इन्द्रमवकर्शयन्ति ।
वृद्धस्य चिद्वर्धतामस्य तनू स्तोमेभिरुक्थैश्च शस्यमाना ॥
verses.rom:
na yam jaranti sharado na masa na dyava indramavakarshayanti |
vriddhasya chidvardhatamasya tanu stomebhirukthaishcha shasyamana ||
verses.en:
That Indra whom nor months nor autumn seasons wither with age, nor fleeting days enfeeble,-
Still may his body Wax, e'en now so mighty, glorified by the lauds and hymns that praise him.

verses.sa:
न वीळवे नमते न स्थिराय न शर्धते दस्युजूताय स्तवान् ।
अज्रा इन्द्रस्य गिरयश्चिदृष्वा गम्भीरे चिद्भवति गाधमस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
na vilave namate na sthiraya na shardhate dasyujutaya stavan |
ajra indrasya girayashchidrishva gambhire chidbhavati gadhamasmai ||
verses.en:
Extolled, he bends not to the strong, the steadfast, nor to the bold incited by the Dasyu.
High mountains are as level plains to Indra: even in the deep he finds firm ground to rest on.

verses.sa:
गम्भीरेण न उरुणामत्रिन्प्रेषो यन्धि सुतपावन्वाजान् ।
स्था ऊ षु ऊर्ध्व ऊती अरिषण्यन्नक्तोर्व्युष्टौ परितक्म्यायाम् ॥
verses.rom:
gambhirena na urunamatrinpresho yandhi sutapavanvajan |
stha u shu urdhva uti arishanyannaktorvyushtau paritakmyayam ||
verses.en:
Impetuous Speeder through all depth and distance, give strengthening food, thou drinker of the juices.
Stand up erect to help us, unreluctant, what time the gloom of night brightens to morning.

verses.sa:
सचस्व नायमवसे अभीक इतो वा तमिन्द्र पाहि रिषः ।
अमा चैनमरण्ये पाहि रिषो मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
verses.rom:
sachasva nayamavase abhika ito va tamindra pahi rishah |
ama chainamaranye pahi risho madema shatahimah suvirah ||
verses.en:
Hasting to help, come hither and protect him, keep him from harm when he is here, O Indra.
At home, abroad, from injury preserve him. May brave sons gladden us through a hundred winters.

verses.sa:
या त ऊतिरवमा या परमा या मध्यमेन्द्र शुष्मिन्नस्ति ।
ताभिरू षु वृत्रहत्येऽवीर्न एभिश्च वाजैर्महान्न उग्र ॥
verses.rom:
ya ta utiravama ya parama ya madhyamendra shushminnasti |
tabhiru shu vritrahatye'virna ebhishcha vajairmahanna ugra ||
verses.en:
WITH thine assistance, O thou Mighty Indra, be it the least, the midmost, or the highest,-
Great with those aids and by these powers support us, Strong God! in battle that subdues our foemen.

verses.sa:
आभि स्पृधो मिथतीररिषण्यन्नमित्रस्य व्यथया मन्युमिन्द्र ।
आभिर्विश्वा अभियुजो विषूचीरार्याय विशोऽव तारीर्दासीः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi spridho mithatirarishanyannamitrasya vyathaya manyumindra |
abhirvishva abhiyujo vishuchiraryaya visho'va tarirdasih ||
verses.en:
With these discomfit hosts that fight against us, and check the opponent's wrath, thyself uninjured.
With these chase all our foes to every quarter: subdue the tribes of Dasas to the Arya.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र जामय उत येऽजामयोऽर्वाचीनासो वनुषो युयुज्रे ।
त्वमेषां विथुरा शवांसि जहि वृष्ण्यानि कृणुही पराचः ॥
verses.rom:
indra jamaya uta ye'jamayo'rvachinaso vanusho yuyujre |
tvamesham vithura shavamsi jahi vrishnyani krinuhi parachah ||
verses.en:
Those who array themselves as foes to smite us, O Indra, be they kin or be they strangers,-
Strike thou their manly strength that it be feeble, and drive in headlong flight our foemen backward.

verses.sa:
शूरो वा शूरं वनते शरीरैस्तनूरुचा तरुषि यत्कृण्वैते ।
तोके वा गोषु तनये यदप्सु वि क्रन्दसी उर्वरासु ब्रवैते ॥
verses.rom:
shuro va shuram vanate shariraistanurucha tarushi yatkrinvaite |
toke va goshu tanaye yadapsu vi krandasi urvarasu bravaite ||
verses.en:
With strength of limb the hero slays the hero, when bright in arms they range them for the combat.
When two opposing hosts contend in battle for seed and offspring, waters, kine, or corn-lands.

verses.sa:
नहि त्वा शूरो न तुरो न धृष्णुर्न त्वा योधो मन्यमानो युयोध ।
इन्द्र नकिष्ट्वा प्रत्यस्त्येषां विश्वा जातान्यभ्यसि तानि ॥
verses.rom:
nahi tva shuro na turo na dhrishnurna tva yodho manyamano yuyodha |
indra nakishtva pratyastyesham vishva jatanyabhyasi tani ||
verses.en:
Yet no strong man hath conquered thee, no hero, no brave, no warrior trusting in his valour.
Not one of these is match for thee, O Indra. Thou far surpassest all these living creatures.

verses.sa:
स पत्यत उभयोर्नृम्णमयोर्यदी वेधसः समिथे हवन्ते ।
वृत्रे वा महो नृवति क्षये वा व्यचस्वन्ता यदि वितन्तसैते ॥
verses.rom:
sa patyata ubhayornrimnamayoryadi vedhasah samithe havante |
vritre va maho nrivati kshaye va vyachasvanta yadi vitantasaite ||
verses.en:
He is the Lord of both these armies' valour when the commanders call them to the conflict:
When with their ranks expanded they are fighting with a great foe or for a home with heroes.

verses.sa:
अध स्मा ते चर्षणयो यदेजानिन्द्र त्रातोत भवा वरूता ।
अस्माकासो ये नृतमासो अर्य इन्द्र सूरयो दधिरे पुरो नः ॥
verses.rom:
adha sma te charshanayo yadejanindra tratota bhava varuta |
asmakaso ye nritamaso arya indra surayo dadhire puro nah ||
verses.en:
And when the people stir themselves for battle, be thou their saviour, Indra, and protector,
And theirs, thy manliest of our friends, the pious, the chiefs who have installed us priests, O Indra.

verses.sa:
अनु ते दायि मह इन्द्रियाय सत्रा ते विश्वमनु वृत्रहत्ये ।
अनु क्षत्रमनु सहो यजत्रेन्द्र देवेभिरनु ते नृषह्ये ॥
verses.rom:
anu te dayi maha indriyaya satra te vishvamanu vritrahatye |
anu kshatramanu saho yajatrendra devebhiranu te nrishahye ||
verses.en:
To thee for high dominion hath been for evermore, for slaughtering the Vrtras,
All lordly power and might, O Holy Indra, given by Gods for victory in battle.

verses.sa:
एवा न स्पृधः समजा समत्स्विन्द्र रारन्धि मिथतीरदेवीः ।
विद्याम वस्तोरवसा गृणन्तो भरद्वाजा उत त इन्द्र नूनम् ॥
verses.rom:
eva na spridhah samaja samatsvindra rarandhi mithatiradevih |
vidyama vastoravasa grinanto bharadvaja uta ta indra nunam ||
verses.en:
So urge our hosts together in the combats: yield up the godless bands that fight against us.
Singing, at morn may we find thee with favour, yea, Indra, and e'en now, we Bharadvajas.

verses.sa:
श्रुधी न इन्द्र ह्वयामसि त्वा महो वाजस्य सातौ वावृषाणाः ।
सं यद्विशोऽयन्त शूरसाता उग्रं नोऽवः पार्ये अहन्दाः ॥
verses.rom:
shrudhi na indra hvayamasi tva maho vajasya satau vavrishanah |
sam yadvisho'yanta shurasata ugram no'vah parye ahandah ||
verses.en:
O INDRA, hear us. Raining down the Soma, we call on thee to win us mighty valour.
Give us strong succour on the day of trial, when the tribes gather on the field of battle.

verses.sa:
त्वां वाजी हवते वाजिनेयो महो वाजस्य गध्यस्य सातौ ।
त्वां वृत्रेष्विन्द्र सत्पतिं तरुत्रं त्वां चष्टे मुष्टिहा गोषु युध्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vaji havate vajineyo maho vajasya gadhyasya satau |
tvam vritreshvindra satpatim tarutram tvam chashte mushtiha goshu yudhyan ||
verses.en:
The warrior, son of warrior sire, invokes thee, to gain great strength that may be won as booty:
To thee, the brave man's Lord, the fiends' subduer, he looks when fighting hand to hand for cattle.

verses.sa:
त्वं कविं चोदयोऽर्कसातौ त्वं कुत्साय शुष्णं दाशुषे वर्क् ।
त्वं शिरो अमर्मणः पराहन्नतिथिग्वाय शंस्यं करिष्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam kavim chodayo'rkasatau tvam kutsaya shushnam dashushe vark |
tvam shiro amarmanah parahannatithigvaya shamsyam karishyan ||
verses.en:
Thou didst impel the sage to win the daylight, didst ruin Susna for the pious Kutsa.
The invulnerable demon's head thou clavest when thou wouldst win the praise of Atithigva.

verses.sa:
त्वं रथं प्र भरो योधमृष्वमावो युध्यन्तं वृषभं दशद्युम् ।
त्वं तुग्रं वेतसवे सचाहन्त्वं तुजिं गृणन्तमिन्द्र तूतोः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam ratham pra bharo yodhamrishvamavo yudhyantam vrishabham dashadyum |
tvam tugram vetasave sachahantvam tujim grinantamindra tutoh ||
verses.en:
The lofty battle-car thou broughtest forward; thou holpest Dasadyu the strong when fighting.
Along with Vetasu thou slewest Tugra, and madest Tuji strong, who praised thee, Indra.

verses.sa:
त्वं तदुक्थमिन्द्र बर्हणा कः प्र यच्छता सहस्रा शूर दर्षि ।
अव गिरेर्दासं शम्बरं हन्प्रावो दिवोदासं चित्राभिरूती ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tadukthamindra barhana kah pra yachchhata sahasra shura darshi |
ava girerdasam shambaram hanpravo divodasam chitrabhiruti ||
verses.en:
Thou madest good the laud, what time thou rentest a hundred thousand fighting foes, O Hero,
Slewest the Dasa Sambara of the mountain, and with strange aids didst succour Divodasa.

verses.sa:
त्वं श्रद्धाभिर्मन्दसानः सोमैर्दभीतये चुमुरिमिन्द्र सिष्वप् ।
त्वं रजिं पिठीनसे दशस्यन्षष्टिं सहस्रा शच्या सचाहन् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam shraddhabhirmandasanah somairdabhitaye chumurimindra sishvap |
tvam rajim pithinase dashasyanshashtim sahasra shachya sachahan ||
verses.en:
Made glad with Soma-draughts and faith, thou sentest Cumuri to his sleep, to please Dabhiti.
Thou, kindly giving Raji to Pithinas, slewest with might, at once, the sixty thousand.

verses.sa:
अहं चन तत्सूरिभिरानश्यां तव ज्याय इन्द्र सुम्नमोजः ।
त्वया यत्स्तवन्ते सधवीर वीरास्त्रिवरूथेन नहुषा शविष्ठ ॥
verses.rom:
aham chana tatsuribhiranashyam tava jyaya indra sumnamojah |
tvaya yatstavante sadhavira virastrivaruthena nahusha shavishtha ||
verses.en:
May I too, with the liberal chiefs, O Indra, acquire thy blin supreme and domination,
When, Mightiest! Hero-girt! Nahusa heroes boast them in thee, the triply-strong Defender.

verses.sa:
वयं ते अस्यामिन्द्र द्युम्नहूतौ सखायः स्याम महिन प्रेष्ठाः ।
प्रातर्दनिः क्षत्रश्रीरस्तु श्रेष्ठो घने वृत्राणां सनये धनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vayam te asyamindra dyumnahutau sakhayah syama mahina preshthah |
pratardanih kshatrashrirastu shreshtho ghane vritranam sanaye dhananam ||
verses.en:
So may we he thy friends, thy best beloved, O Indra, at this holy invocation.
Best be Pratardani, illustrious ruler, in slaying foemen and in gaining riches.

verses.sa:
किमस्य मदे किम्वस्य पीताविन्द्रः किमस्य सख्ये चकार ।
रणा वा ये निषदि किं ते अस्य पुरा विविद्रे किमु नूतनासः ॥
verses.rom:
kimasya made kimvasya pitavindrah kimasya sakhye chakara |
rana va ye nishadi kim te asya pura vividre kimu nutanasah ||
verses.en:
WHAT deed hath Indra done in the wild transport, in quaffing or in friendship with, the Soma?
What joys have men of ancient times or recent obtained within the chamber of libation?

verses.sa:
सदस्य मदे सद्वस्य पीताविन्द्रः सदस्य सख्ये चकार ।
रणा वा ये निषदि सत्ते अस्य पुरा विविद्रे सदु नूतनासः ॥
verses.rom:
sadasya made sadvasya pitavindrah sadasya sakhye chakara |
rana va ye nishadi satte asya pura vividre sadu nutanasah ||
verses.en:
In its wild joy Indra hath proved him faithful, faithful in quaffing, faithful in its friendship.
His truth is the delight that in this chamber the men of old and recent times have tasted.

verses.sa:
नहि नु ते महिमनः समस्य न मघवन्मघवत्त्वस्य विद्म ।
न राधसोराधसो नूतनस्येन्द्र नकिर्ददृश इन्द्रियं ते ॥
verses.rom:
nahi nu te mahimanah samasya na maghavanmaghavattvasya vidma |
na radhasoradhaso nutanasyendra nakirdadrisha indriyam te ||
verses.en:
All thy vast power, O Maghavan, we know not, know not the riches of thy full abundance.
No one hath seen that might of thine, productive of bounty every day renewed, O Indra.

verses.sa:
एतत्त्यत्त इन्द्रियमचेति येनावधीर्वरशिखस्य शेषः ।
वज्रस्य यत्ते निहतस्य शुष्मात्स्वनाच्चिदिन्द्र परमो ददार ॥
verses.rom:
etattyatta indriyamacheti yenavadhirvarashikhasya sheshah |
vajrasya yatte nihatasya shushmatsvanachchidindra paramo dadara ||
verses.en:
This one great power of thine our eyes have witnessed, wherewith thou slewest Varasikha's children,
When by the force of thy descending thunder, at the mere sound, their boldest was demolished.

verses.sa:
वधीदिन्द्रो वरशिखस्य शेषोऽभ्यावर्तिने चायमानाय शिक्षन् ।
वृचीवतो यद्धरियूपीयायां हन्पूर्वे अर्धे भियसापरो दर्त् ॥
verses.rom:
vadhidindro varashikhasya shesho'bhyavartine chayamanaya shikshan |
vrichivato yaddhariyupiyayam hanpurve ardhe bhiyasaparo dart ||
verses.en:
In aid of Abhyavartin Cayamana, Indra destroyed the seed of Varasikha.
At Hariyupiya he smote the vanguard of the Vrcivans, and the rear fled frighted.

verses.sa:
त्रिंशच्छतं वर्मिण इन्द्र साकं यव्यावत्यां पुरुहूत श्रवस्या ।
वृचीवन्तः शरवे पत्यमानाः पात्रा भिन्दाना न्यर्थान्यायन् ॥
verses.rom:
trimshachchhatam varmina indra sakam yavyavatyam puruhuta shravasya |
vrichivantah sharave patyamanah patra bhindana nyarthanyayan ||
verses.en:
Three thousand, mailed, in quest of fame, together, on the Yavyavati, O much-sought Indra,
Vrcivan's sons, falling before the arrow, like bursting vessels went to their destruction.

verses.sa:
यस्य गावावरुषा सूयवस्यू अन्तरू षु चरतो रेरिहाणा ।
स सृञ्जयाय तुर्वशं परादाद्वृचीवतो दैववाताय शिक्षन् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya gavavarusha suyavasyu antaru shu charato rerihana |
sa srinjayaya turvasham paradadvrichivato daivavataya shikshan ||
verses.en:
He, whose two red Steers, seeking goodly pasture, plying their tongues move on 'twixt earth and heaven,
Gave Turvasa to Srnjaya, and, to aid him, gave the Vrcivans up to Daivavata.

verses.sa:
द्वयाँ अग्ने रथिनो विंशतिं गा वधूमतो मघवा मह्यं सम्राट् ।
अभ्यावर्ती चायमानो ददाति दूणाशेयं दक्षिणा पार्थवानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
dvayan agne rathino vimshatim ga vadhumato maghava mahyam samrat |
abhyavarti chayamano dadati dunasheyam dakshina parthavanam ||
verses.en:
Two wagon-teams, with damsels, twenty oxen, O Agni, Abhydvartin Cayamana,
The liberal Sovran, giveth me. This guerdon of Prthu's seed is hard to win from others.

verses.sa:
आ गावो अग्मन्नुत भद्रमक्रन्सीदन्तु गोष्ठे रणयन्त्वस्मे ।
प्रजावतीः पुरुरूपा इह स्युरिन्द्राय पूर्वीरुषसो दुहानाः ॥
verses.rom:
a gavo agmannuta bhadramakransidantu goshthe ranayantvasme |
prajavatih pururupa iha syurindraya purvirushaso duhanah ||
verses.en:
THE Kine have come and brought good fortune: let them rest in the cow-pen and be happy near us.
Here let them stay prolific, many-coloured, and yield through many morns their milk for Indra.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो यज्वने पृणते च शिक्षत्युपेद्ददाति न स्वं मुषायति ।
भूयोभूयो रयिमिदस्य वर्धयन्नभिन्ने खिल्ये नि दधाति देवयुम् ॥
verses.rom:
indro yajvane prinate cha shikshatyupeddadati na svam mushayati |
bhuyobhuyo rayimidasya vardhayannabhinne khilye ni dadhati devayum ||
verses.en:
Indra aids him who offers sacrifice and gifts: he takes not what is his, and gives him more thereto.
Increasing ever more and ever more his wealth, he makes the pious dwell within unbroken bounds.

verses.sa:
न ता नशन्ति न दभाति तस्करो नासामामित्रो व्यथिरा दधर्षति ।
देवाँश्च याभिर्यजते ददाति च ज्योगित्ताभिः सचते गोपतिः सह ॥
verses.rom:
na ta nashanti na dabhati taskaro nasamamitro vyathira dadharshati |
devanshcha yabhiryajate dadati cha jyogittabhih sachate gopatih saha ||
verses.en:
These are ne'er lost, no robber ever injures them: no evil-minded foe attempts to harass them.
The master of the Kine lives many a year with these, the Cows whereby he pours his gifts and serves the Gods.

verses.sa:
न ता अर्वा रेणुककाटो अश्नुते न संस्कृतत्रमुप यन्ति ता अभि ।
उरुगायमभयं तस्य ता अनु गावो मर्तस्य वि चरन्ति यज्वनः ॥
verses.rom:
na ta arva renukakato ashnute na samskritatramupa yanti ta abhi |
urugayamabhayam tasya ta anu gavo martasya vi charanti yajvanah ||
verses.en:
The charger with his dusty brow o'ertakes them not, and never to the shambles do they take their way.
These Cows, the cattle of the pious worshipper, roam over widespread pasture where no danger is.

verses.sa:
गावो भगो गाव इन्द्रो मे अच्छान्गावः सोमस्य प्रथमस्य भक्षः ।
इमा या गावः स जनास इन्द्र इच्छामीद्धृदा मनसा चिदिन्द्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
gavo bhago gava indro me achchhangavah somasya prathamasya bhakshah |
ima ya gavah sa janasa indra ichchhamiddhrida manasa chidindram ||
verses.en:
To me the Cows seem Bhaga, they seem Indra, they seem a portion of the first-poured Soma.
These present Cows, they, O ye Indra. I long for Indra with my heart and spirit.

verses.sa:
यूयं गावो मेदयथा कृशं चिदश्रीरं चित्कृणुथा सुप्रतीकम् ।
भद्रं गृहं कृणुथ भद्रवाचो बृहद्वो वय उच्यते सभासु ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam gavo medayatha krisham chidashriram chitkrinutha supratikam |
bhadram griham krinutha bhadravacho brihadvo vaya uchyate sabhasu ||
verses.en:
O Cows, ye fatten e'en the worn and wasted, and make the unlovely beautiful tolook on.
Prosper my house, ye with auspicious voices. Your power is glorified in our assemblies.

verses.sa:
प्रजावतीः सूयवसं रिशन्तीः शुद्धा अपः सुप्रपाणे पिबन्तीः ।
मा व स्तेन ईशत माघशंसः परि वो हेती रुद्रस्य वृज्याः ॥
verses.rom:
prajavatih suyavasam rishantih shuddha apah suprapane pibantih |
ma va stena ishata maghashamsah pari vo heti rudrasya vrijyah ||
verses.en:
Crop goodly pasturage and be prolific drink pure sweet water at good drinking places.
Never be thief or sinful man your matter, and may the dart of Rudra still avoid you.

verses.sa:
उपेदमुपपर्चनमासु गोषूप पृच्यताम् ।
उप ऋषभस्य रेतस्युपेन्द्र तव वीर्ये ॥
verses.rom:
upedamupaparchanamasu goshupa prichyatam |
upa rishabhasya retasyupendra tava virye ||
verses.en:
Now let this close admixture be close intermigled with these Cows,
Mixt with the Steer's prolific flow, and, Indra, with thy hero might.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं वो नरः सख्याय सेपुर्महो यन्तः सुमतये चकानाः ।
महो हि दाता वज्रहस्तो अस्ति महामु रण्वमवसे यजध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
indram vo narah sakhyaya sepurmaho yantah sumataye chakanah |
maho hi data vajrahasto asti mahamu ranvamavase yajadhvam ||
verses.en:
YOUR men have followed Indra for his friendship, and for his loving-kindness glorified him.
For he bestows great wealth, the Thunder-wielder: worship him, Great and Kind, to win his favour.

verses.sa:
आ यस्मिन्हस्ते नर्या मिमिक्षुरा रथे हिरण्यये रथेष्ठाः ।
आ रश्मयो गभस्त्यो स्थूरयोराध्वन्नश्वासो वृषणो युजानाः ॥
verses.rom:
a yasminhaste narya mimikshura rathe hiranyaye ratheshthah |
a rashmayo gabhastyo sthurayoradhvannashvaso vrishano yujanah ||
verses.en:
Him to whose hand, men closely cling, and drivers stand on his golden chariot firmly stationed.
With his firm arms he holds the reins; his Horses, the Stallions, are yoked ready for the journey.

verses.sa:
श्रिये ते पादा दुव आ मिमिक्षुर्धृष्णुर्वज्री शवसा दक्षिणावान् ।
वसानो अत्कं सुरभिं दृशे कं स्वर्ण नृतविषिरो बभूथ ॥
verses.rom:
shriye te pada duva a mimikshurdhrishnurvajri shavasa dakshinavan |
vasano atkam surabhim drishe kam svarna nritavishiro babhutha ||
verses.en:
Thy devotees embrace thy feet for glory. Bold, thunder-armed, rich, through thy strength, in guerdon,
Robed in a garment fair as heaven to look on, thou hast displayed thee like an active dancer.

verses.sa:
स सोम आमिश्लतमः सुतो भूद्यस्मिन्पक्तिः पच्यते सन्ति धानाः ।
इन्द्रं नर स्तुवन्तो ब्रह्मकारा उक्था शंसन्तो देववाततमाः ॥
verses.rom:
sa soma amishlatamah suto bhudyasminpaktih pachyate santi dhanah |
indram nara stuvanto brahmakara uktha shamsanto devavatatamah ||
verses.en:
That Soma when effused hath best consistence, for which the food is dressed and grain is mingled;
By which the men who pray, extolling Indra chief favourites of Gods, recite their praises.

verses.sa:
न ते अन्तः शवसो धाय्यस्य वि तु बाबधे रोदसी महित्वा ।
आ ता सूरिः पृणति तूतुजानो यूथेवाप्सु समीजमान ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
na te antah shavaso dhayyasya vi tu babadhe rodasi mahitva |
a ta surih prinati tutujano yuthevapsu samijamana uti ||
verses.en:
No limit of thy might hath been appointed, which by its greatness sundered earth and heaven.
These the Prince filleth full with strong endeavour, driving, as 'twere, with help his flocks to waters.

verses.sa:
एवेदिन्द्रः सुहव ऋष्वो अस्तूती अनूती हिरिशिप्रः सत्वा ।
एवा हि जातो असमात्योजाः पुरू च वृत्रा हनति नि दस्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
evedindrah suhava rishvo astuti anuti hirishiprah satva |
eva hi jato asamatyojah puru cha vritra hanati ni dasyun ||
verses.en:
So be the lofty Indra prompt to listen, Helper unaided, golden-visored Hero.
Yea, so may he, shown forth in might unequalled, smite down the many Vrtras and the Dasyus.

verses.sa:
भूय इद्वावृधे वीर्यायँ एको अजुर्यो दयते वसूनि ।
प्र रिरिचे दिव इन्द्रः पृथिव्या अर्धमिदस्य प्रति रोदसी उभे ॥
verses.rom:
bhuya idvavridhe viryayan eko ajuryo dayate vasuni |
pra ririche diva indrah prithivya ardhamidasya prati rodasi ubhe ||
verses.en:
INDRA hath waxed yet more for hero prowess, alone, Eternal, he bestoweth treasures.
Indra transcendeth both the worlds in greatness: one half of him equalleth earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
अधा मन्ये बृहदसुर्यमस्य यानि दाधार नकिरा मिनाति ।
दिवेदिवे सूर्यो दर्शतो भूद्वि सद्मान्युर्विया सुक्रतुर्धात् ॥
verses.rom:
adha manye brihadasuryamasya yani dadhara nakira minati |
divedive suryo darshato bhudvi sadmanyurviya sukraturdhat ||
verses.en:
Yea, mighty I esteem his Godlike nature: none hindereth what he hath once determined.
Near and afar he spread and set the regions, and every day the Sun became apparent.

verses.sa:
अद्या चिन्नू चित्तदपो नदीनां यदाभ्यो अरदो गातुमिन्द्र ।
नि पर्वता अद्मसदो न सेदुस्त्वया दृळ्हानि सुक्रतो रजांसि ॥
verses.rom:
adya chinnu chittadapo nadinam yadabhyo arado gatumindra |
ni parvata admasado na sedustvaya drilhani sukrato rajamsi ||
verses.en:
E'en now endures thine exploit of the Rivers, when, Indra, for their floods thou clavest passage.
Like men who sit at meat the mountains settled: by thee, Most Wise! the regions were made steadfast.

verses.sa:
सत्यमित्तन्न त्वावाँ अन्यो अस्तीन्द्र देवो न मर्त्यो ज्यायान् ।
अहन्नहिं परिशयानमर्णोऽवासृजो अपो अच्छा समुद्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
satyamittanna tvavan anyo astindra devo na martyo jyayan |
ahannahim parishayanamarno'vasrijo apo achchha samudram ||
verses.en:
This is the truth, none else is like thee, Indra, no God superior to thee, no mortal.
Thou slewest Ahi who besieged the waters, and lettest loose the streams to hurry seaward.

verses.sa:
त्वमपो वि दुरो विषूचीरिन्द्र दृळ्हमरुजः पर्वतस्य ।
राजाभवो जगतश्चर्षणीनां साकं सूर्यं जनयन्द्यामुषासम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamapo vi duro vishuchirindra drilhamarujah parvatasya |
rajabhavo jagatashcharshaninam sakam suryam janayandyamushasam ||
verses.en:
Indra, thou breakest up the floods and portals on all sides, and the firmness of the mountain.
Thou art the King of men, of all that liveth, engendering at once Sun, Heaven, and Morning.

verses.sa:
अभूरेको रयिपते रयीणामा हस्तयोरधिथा इन्द्र कृष्टीः ।
वि तोके अप्सु तनये च सूरेऽवोचन्त चर्षणयो विवाचः ॥
verses.rom:
abhureko rayipate rayinama hastayoradhitha indra krishtih |
vi toke apsu tanaye cha sure'vochanta charshanayo vivachah ||
verses.en:
SOLE Lord of wealth art thou, O Lord of riches: thou in thine hands hast held the people, Indra!
Men have invoked thee with contending voices for seed and waters, progeny and sunlight.

verses.sa:
त्वद्भियेन्द्र पार्थिवानि विश्वाच्युता चिच्च्यावयन्ते रजांसि ।
द्यावाक्षामा पर्वतासो वनानि विश्वं दृळ्हं भयते अज्मन्ना ते ॥
verses.rom:
tvadbhiyendra parthivani vishvachyuta chichchyavayante rajamsi |
dyavakshama parvataso vanani vishvam drilham bhayate ajmanna te ||
verses.en:
Through fear of thee, O Indra, all the regions of earth, though naught may move them, shake and tremble.
All that is firm is frightened at thy coming, -the earth, the heaven, the mountain, and the forest.

verses.sa:
त्वं कुत्सेनाभि शुष्णमिन्द्राशुषं युध्य कुयवं गविष्टौ ।
दश प्रपित्वे अध सूर्यस्य मुषायश्चक्रमविवे रपांसि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam kutsenabhi shushnamindrashusham yudhya kuyavam gavishtau |
dasha prapitve adha suryasya mushayashchakramavive rapamsi ||
verses.en:
With Kutsa, Indra! thou didst conquer Susna, voracious, bane of crops, in fight for cattle.
In the close fray thou rentest him: thou stolest the Sun's wheel and didst drive away misfortunes.

verses.sa:
त्वं शतान्यव शम्बरस्य पुरो जघन्थाप्रतीनि दस्योः ।
अशिक्षो यत्र शच्या शचीवो दिवोदासाय सुन्वते सुतक्रे भरद्वाजाय गृणते वसूनि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam shatanyava shambarasya puro jaghanthapratini dasyoh |
ashiksho yatra shachya shachivo divodasaya sunvate sutakre bharadvajaya grinate vasuni ||
verses.en:
Thou smotest to the ground the hundred castles, impregnable, of Sambara the Dasyu,
When, Strong, with might thou holpest Divodasa who poured libations out, O Soma-buyer, and madest Bharadvaja rich who praised thee.

verses.sa:
स सत्यसत्वन्महते रणाय रथमा तिष्ठ तुविनृम्ण भीमम् ।
याहि प्रपथिन्नवसोप मद्रिक्प्र च श्रुत श्रावय चर्षणिभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sa satyasatvanmahate ranaya rathama tishtha tuvinrimna bhimam |
yahi prapathinnavasopa madrikpra cha shruta shravaya charshanibhyah ||
verses.en:
As such, true Hero, for great joy of battle mount thy terrific car, O Brave and Manly.
Come with thine help to me, thou distant Roamer, and, glorious God, spread among men my glory.

verses.sa:
अपूर्व्या पुरुतमान्यस्मै महे वीराय तवसे तुराय ।
विरप्शिने वज्रिणे शंतमानि वचांस्यासा स्थविराय तक्षम् ॥
verses.rom:
apurvya purutamanyasmai mahe viraya tavase turaya |
virapshine vajrine shamtamani vachamsyasa sthaviraya taksham ||
verses.en:
I WITH my lips have fashioned for this Hero words never matched, most plentiful and auspicious,
For him the Ancient, Great, Strong, Energetic, the very mighty Wielder of the Thunder.

verses.sa:
स मातरा सूर्येणा कवीनामवासयद्रुजदद्रिं गृणानः ।
स्वाधीभिरृक्वभिर्वावशान उदुस्रियाणामसृजन्निदानम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa matara suryena kavinamavasayadrujadadrim grinanah |
svadhibhirrikvabhirvavashana udusriyanamasrijannidanam ||
verses.en:
Amid the sages, with the Sun he brightened the Parents: glorified, he burst the mountain;
And, roaring with the holy-thoughted singers, he loosed the bond that held the beams of Morning.

verses.sa:
स वह्निभिरृक्वभिर्गोषु शश्वन्मितज्ञुभिः पुरुकृत्वा जिगाय ।
पुरः पुरोहा सखिभिः सखीयन्दृळ्हा रुरोज कविभिः कविः सन् ॥
verses.rom:
sa vahnibhirrikvabhirgoshu shashvanmitajnubhih purukritva jigaya |
purah puroha sakhibhih sakhiyandrilha ruroja kavibhih kavih san ||
verses.en:
Famed for great deeds, with priests who kneel and laud him, he still hath conquered in the frays for cattle,
And broken down the forts, the Fort-destroyer, a Friend with friends, a Sage among the sages.

verses.sa:
स नीव्याभिर्जरितारमच्छा महो वाजेभिर्महद्भिश्च शुष्मैः ।
पुरुवीराभिर्वृषभ क्षितीनामा गिर्वणः सुविताय प्र याहि ॥
verses.rom:
sa nivyabhirjaritaramachchha maho vajebhirmahadbhishcha shushmaih |
puruvirabhirvrishabha kshitinama girvanah suvitaya pra yahi ||
verses.en:
Come with thy girthed mares, with abundant vigour and plenteous strength to him who sings thy praises.
Come hither, borne by mares with many heroes, Lover of song! Steer! for the people's welfare.

verses.sa:
स सर्गेण शवसा तक्तो अत्यैरप इन्द्रो दक्षिणतस्तुराषाट् ।
इत्था सृजाना अनपावृदर्थं दिवेदिवे विविषुरप्रमृष्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa sargena shavasa takto atyairapa indro dakshinatasturashat |
ittha srijana anapavridartham divedive vivishurapramrishyam ||
verses.en:
Indra with rush and might, sped by his Coursers, hath swiftly won the waters from the southward.
Thus set at liberty the rivers daily flow to their goal, incessant and exhaustless.

verses.sa:
य ओजिष्ठ इन्द्र तं सु नो दा मदो वृषन्स्वभिष्टिर्दास्वान् ।
सौवश्व्यं यो वनवत्स्वश्वो वृत्रा समत्सु सासहदमित्रान् ॥
verses.rom:
ya ojishtha indra tam su no da mado vrishansvabhishtirdasvan |
sauvashvyam yo vanavatsvashvo vritra samatsu sasahadamitran ||
verses.en:
GIVE us the rapture that is mightiest, Indra, prompt to bestow and swift to aid, O Hero,
That wins with brave steeds where brave steeds encounter, and quells the Vrtras and the foes in battle.

verses.sa:
त्वां हीन्द्रावसे विवाचो हवन्ते चर्षणयः शूरसातौ ।
त्वं विप्रेभिर्वि पणीँरशायस्त्वोत इत्सनिता वाजमर्वा ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hindravase vivacho havante charshanayah shurasatau |
tvam viprebhirvi paninrashayastvota itsanita vajamarva ||
verses.en:
For with loud voice the tribes invoke thee, Indra, to aid them in the battlefield of heroes.
Thou, with the singers, hast pierced through the Panis: the charger whom thou aidest wins the booty.

verses.sa:
त्वं ताँ इन्द्रोभयाँ अमित्रान्दासा वृत्राण्यार्या च शूर ।
वधीर्वनेव सुधितेभिरत्कैरा पृत्सु दर्षि नृणां नृतम ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tan indrobhayan amitrandasa vritranyarya cha shura |
vadhirvaneva sudhitebhiratkaira pritsu darshi nrinam nritama ||
verses.en:
Both races, Indra, of opposing foemen, O Hero, both the Arya and the Dasa,
Hast thou struck down like woods with well-shot lightnings: thou rentest them in fight, most manly Chieftain!

verses.sa:
स त्वं न इन्द्राकवाभिरूती सखा विश्वायुरविता वृधे भूः ।
स्वर्षाता यद्ध्वयामसि त्वा युध्यन्तो नेमधिता पृत्सु शूर ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvam na indrakavabhiruti sakha vishvayuravita vridhe bhuh |
svarshata yaddhvayamasi tva yudhyanto nemadhita pritsu shura ||
verses.en:
Indra, befriend us with no scanty succour, prosper and aid us, Loved of all that liveth,
When, fighting for the sunlight, we invoke thee, O Hero, in the fray, in war's division.

verses.sa:
नूनं न इन्द्रापराय च स्या भवा मृळीक उत नो अभिष्टौ ।
इत्था गृणन्तो महिनस्य शर्मन्दिवि ष्याम पार्ये गोषतमाः ॥
verses.rom:
nunam na indraparaya cha sya bhava mrilika uta no abhishtau |
ittha grinanto mahinasya sharmandivi shyama parye goshatamah ||
verses.en:
Be ours, O Indra, now and for the future, be graciously inclined and near to help us.
Thus may we, singing, sheltered by the Mighty, win many cattle on the day of trial.

verses.sa:
सं च त्वे जग्मुर्गिर इन्द्र पूर्वीर्वि च त्वद्यन्ति विभ्वो मनीषाः ।
पुरा नूनं च स्तुतय ऋषीणां पस्पृध्र इन्द्रे अध्युक्थार्का ॥
verses.rom:
sam cha tve jagmurgira indra purvirvi cha tvadyanti vibhvo manishah |
pura nunam cha stutaya rishinam paspridhra indre adhyuktharka ||
verses.en:
FULL Many songs have met in thee, O Indra, and many a noble thought from thee proceedeth.
Now and of old the eulogies of sages, their holy hymns and lauds, have yearned for Indra.

verses.sa:
पुरुहूतो यः पुरुगूर्त ऋभ्वाँ एकः पुरुप्रशस्तो अस्ति यज्ञैः ।
रथो न महे शवसे युजानोऽस्माभिरिन्द्रो अनुमाद्यो भूत् ॥
verses.rom:
puruhuto yah purugurta ribhvan ekah puruprashasto asti yajnaih |
ratho na mahe shavase yujano'smabhirindro anumadyo bhut ||
verses.en:
He, praised of many, bold, invoked of many, alone is glorified at sacrifices.
Like a car harnessed for some great achievement, Indra must be the cause of our rejoicing.

verses.sa:
न यं हिंसन्ति धीतयो न वाणीरिन्द्रं नक्षन्तीदभि वर्धयन्तीः ।
यदि स्तोतारः शतं यत्सहस्रं गृणन्ति गिर्वणसं शं तदस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
na yam himsanti dhitayo na vanirindram nakshantidabhi vardhayantih |
yadi stotarah shatam yatsahasram grinanti girvanasam sham tadasmai ||
verses.en:
They make their way to Indra and exalt him, bim whom no prayers and no laudations trouble;
For when a hundred or a thousand singers. laud him who loves the song their praise delights him.

verses.sa:
अस्मा एतद्दिव्यर्चेव मासा मिमिक्ष इन्द्रे न्ययामि सोमः ।
जनं न धन्वन्नभि सं यदापः सत्रा वावृधुर्हवनानि यज्ञैः ॥
verses.rom:
asma etaddivyarcheva masa mimiksha indre nyayami somah |
janam na dhanvannabhi sam yadapah satra vavridhurhavanani yajnaih ||
verses.en:
As brightness mingles with the Moon in heaven, the offered Soma yearns to mix with Indra.
Like water brought to men in desert places, our gifts at sacrifice have still refreshed him.

verses.sa:
अस्मा एतन्मह्याङ्गूषमस्मा इन्द्राय स्तोत्रं मतिभिरवाचि ।
असद्यथा महति वृत्रतूर्य इन्द्रो विश्वायुरविता वृधश्च ॥
verses.rom:
asma etanmahyangushamasma indraya stotram matibhiravachi |
asadyatha mahati vritraturya indro vishvayuravita vridhashcha ||
verses.en:
To him this mighty eulogy, to Indra hath this our laud been uttered by the poets,
That in the great encounter with the foemen, Loved of all life, Indra may guard and help us.

verses.sa:
कदा भुवन्रथक्षयाणि ब्रह्म कदा स्तोत्रे सहस्रपोष्यं दाः ।
कदा स्तोमं वासयोऽस्य राया कदा धियः करसि वाजरत्नाः ॥
verses.rom:
kada bhuvanrathakshayani brahma kada stotre sahasraposhyam dah |
kada stomam vasayo'sya raya kada dhiyah karasi vajaratnah ||
verses.en:
WHEN shall our prayers rest in thy car beside thee? When dost thou give the singer food for thousands?
When wilt thou clothe this poet's laud with plenty, and when wilt thou enrich our hymns with booty?

verses.sa:
कर्हि स्वित्तदिन्द्र यन्नृभिर्नॄन्वीरैर्वीरान्नीळयासे जयाजीन् ।
त्रिधातु गा अधि जयासि गोष्विन्द्र द्युम्नं स्वर्वद्धेह्यस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
karhi svittadindra yannribhirnrinvirairvirannilayase jayajin |
tridhatu ga adhi jayasi goshvindra dyumnam svarvaddhehyasme ||
verses.en:
When wilt thou gatber men with men, O Indra, heroes with heroes, and prevail in combat?
Thou shalt win triply kine in frays for cattle, so, Indra, give thou us celestial glory.

verses.sa:
कर्हि स्वित्तदिन्द्र यज्जरित्रे विश्वप्सु ब्रह्म कृणवः शविष्ठ ।
कदा धियो न नियुतो युवासे कदा गोमघा हवनानि गच्छाः ॥
verses.rom:
karhi svittadindra yajjaritre vishvapsu brahma krinavah shavishtha |
kada dhiyo na niyuto yuvase kada gomagha havanani gachchhah ||
verses.en:
Yea, when wilt thou, O Indra, thou Most Mighty, make the prayer all-sustaining for the singer?
When wilt thou yoke, as we yoke songs, thy Horses, and come to offerings that bring wealth in cattle?

verses.sa:
स गोमघा जरित्रे अश्वश्चन्द्रा वाजश्रवसो अधि धेहि पृक्षः ।
पीपिहीषः सुदुघामिन्द्र धेनुं भरद्वाजेषु सुरुचो रुरुच्याः ॥
verses.rom:
sa gomagha jaritre ashvashchandra vajashravaso adhi dhehi prikshah |
pipihishah sudughamindra dhenum bharadvajeshu surucho ruruchyah ||
verses.en:
Grant to the Singer food with store of cattle, splendid with horses and the fame of riches.
Send food to swell the milch-cow good at milking: bright be its shine among the Bharadvajas.

verses.sa:
तमा नूनं वृजनमन्यथा चिच्छूरो यच्छक्र वि दुरो गृणीषे ।
मा निररं शुक्रदुघस्य धेनोराङ्गिरसान्ब्रह्मणा विप्र जिन्व ॥
verses.rom:
tama nunam vrijanamanyatha chichchhuro yachchhakra vi duro grinishe |
ma niraram shukradughasya dhenorangirasanbrahmana vipra jinva ||
verses.en:
Lead otherwise this present foeman, Sakra! Hence art thou praised as Hero, foe destroyer
Him who gives pure gifts may I praise unceasing. Sage, quicken the Angirases by devotion.

verses.sa:
सत्रा मदासस्तव विश्वजन्याः सत्रा रायोऽध ये पार्थिवासः ।
सत्रा वाजानामभवो विभक्ता यद्देवेषु धारयथा असुर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
satra madasastava vishvajanyah satra rayo'dha ye parthivasah |
satra vajanamabhavo vibhakta yaddeveshu dharayatha asuryam ||
verses.en:
THY raptures ever were for all men's profit: so evermore have been thine earthly riches.
Thou still hast been the dealer-forth of vigour, since among Gods thou hast had power and Godhead.

verses.sa:
अनु प्र येजे जन ओजो अस्य सत्रा दधिरे अनु वीर्याय ।
स्यूमगृभे दुधयेऽर्वते च क्रतुं वृञ्जन्त्यपि वृत्रहत्ये ॥
verses.rom:
anu pra yeje jana ojo asya satra dadhire anu viryaya |
syumagribhe dudhaye'rvate cha kratum vrinjantyapi vritrahatye ||
verses.en:
Men have obtained his strength by sacrificing, and ever urged him, on to hero valour.
For the rein-seizing, the impetuous Charger they furnished power even for Vrtra's slaughter.

verses.sa:
तं सध्रीचीरूतयो वृष्ण्यानि पौंस्यानि नियुतः सश्चुरिन्द्रम् ।
समुद्रं न सिन्धव उक्थशुष्मा उरुव्यचसं गिर आ विशन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
tam sadhrichirutayo vrishnyani paumsyani niyutah sashchurindram |
samudram na sindhava ukthashushma uruvyachasam gira a vishanti ||
verses.en:
Associate with him, as teams of horses, help, manly might, and vigour follow Indra.
As rivers reach the sea, so, strong with praises, our holy songs reach him the Comprehensive.

verses.sa:
स रायस्खामुप सृजा गृणानः पुरुश्चन्द्रस्य त्वमिन्द्र वस्वः ।
पतिर्बभूथासमो जनानामेको विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा ॥
verses.rom:
sa rayaskhamupa srija grinanah purushchandrasya tvamindra vasvah |
patirbabhuthasamo jananameko vishvasya bhuvanasya raja ||
verses.en:
Lauded by us, let flow the spring, O Indra, of excellent and brightly-shining riches.
For thou art Lord of men, without an equal: of all the world thou art the only Sovran.

verses.sa:
स तु श्रुधि श्रुत्या यो दुवोयुर्द्यौर्न भूमाभि रायो अर्यः ।
असो यथा नः शवसा चकानो युगेयुगे वयसा चेकितानः ॥
verses.rom:
sa tu shrudhi shrutya yo duvoyurdyaurna bhumabhi rayo aryah |
aso yatha nah shavasa chakano yugeyuge vayasa chekitanah ||
verses.en:
Hear what thou mayst hear, thou who, fain for worship, as heaven girds earth, guardest thy servant's treasure;
Tlat thou mayst be our own, joying in power, famed through thy might in every generation.

verses.sa:
अर्वाग्रथं विश्ववारं त उग्रेन्द्र युक्तासो हरयो वहन्तु ।
कीरिश्चिद्धि त्वा हवते स्वर्वानृधीमहि सधमादस्ते अद्य ॥
verses.rom:
arvagratham vishvavaram ta ugrendra yuktaso harayo vahantu |
kirishchiddhi tva havate svarvanridhimahi sadhamadaste adya ||
verses.en:
LET thy Bay Horses, yoked, O mighty Indra, bring thy car hither fraught with every blessing.
For thee, the Heavenly, e'en the poor invoketh: may we this day, thy feast-companions, prosper.

verses.sa:
प्रो द्रोणे हरयः कर्माग्मन्पुनानास ऋज्यन्तो अभूवन् ।
इन्द्रो नो अस्य पूर्व्यः पपीयाद्द्युक्षो मदस्य सोम्यस्य राजा ॥
verses.rom:
pro drone harayah karmagmanpunanasa rijyanto abhuvan |
indro no asya purvyah papiyaddyuksho madasya somyasya raja ||
verses.en:
Forth to the vat the brown drops flow for service, and purified proceed directly forward.
May Indra drink of this, our guest aforetime, Celestial King of the strong draught of Soma.

verses.sa:
आसस्राणासः शवसानमच्छेन्द्रं सुचक्रे रथ्यासो अश्वाः ।
अभि श्रव ऋज्यन्तो वहेयुर्नू चिन्नु वायोरमृतं वि दस्येत् ॥
verses.rom:
asasranasah shavasanamachchhendram suchakre rathyaso ashvah |
abhi shrava rijyanto vaheyurnu chinnu vayoramritam vi dasyet ||
verses.en:
Bringing us hitherward all-potent Indra on well-wheeled chariot, may the Steeds who bear him
Convey him on the road direct to glory, and ne'er may Vayu's Amrta cease and fail him.

verses.sa:
वरिष्ठो अस्य दक्षिणामियर्तीन्द्रो मघोनां तुविकूर्मितमः ।
यया वज्रिवः परियास्यंहो मघा च धृष्णो दयसे वि सूरीन् ॥
verses.rom:
varishtho asya dakshinamiyartindro maghonam tuvikurmitamah |
yaya vajrivah pariyasyamho magha cha dhrishno dayase vi surin ||
verses.en:
Supreme, he stirs this man to give the guerdon,-Indra, most efficacious of the princes,-
Wherewith, O Thunderer, thou removest sorrow, and, Bold One! partest wealth among the nobles.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वाजस्य स्थविरस्य दातेन्द्रो गीर्भिर्वर्धतां वृद्धमहाः ।
इन्द्रो वृत्रं हनिष्ठो अस्तु सत्वा ता सूरिः पृणति तूतुजानः ॥
verses.rom:
indro vajasya sthavirasya datendro girbhirvardhatam vriddhamahah |
indro vritram hanishtho astu satva ta surih prinati tutujanah ||
verses.en:
Indra is hewho gives enduring vigour: may our songs magnify the God Most Mighty.
Best Vrtra-slayer be the Hero Indra these things he gives as Prince, with strong endeavour.

verses.sa:
अपादित उदु नश्चित्रतमो महीं भर्षद्द्युमतीमिन्द्रहूतिम् ।
पन्यसीं धीतिं दैव्यस्य यामञ्जनस्य रातिं वनते सुदानुः ॥
verses.rom:
apadita udu nashchitratamo mahim bharshaddyumatimindrahutim |
panyasim dhitim daivyasya yamanjanasya ratim vanate sudanuh ||
verses.en:
HE hath drunk hence, Most Marvellous, and carried away our great and splendid call on Indra.
The Bounteous, when we serve the Gods, accepteth song yet more famous and the gifts we bring him.

verses.sa:
दूराच्चिदा वसतो अस्य कर्णा घोषादिन्द्रस्य तन्यति ब्रुवाणः ।
एयमेनं देवहूतिर्ववृत्यान्मद्र्यगिन्द्रमियमृच्यमाना ॥
verses.rom:
durachchida vasato asya karna ghoshadindrasya tanyati bruvanah |
eyamenam devahutirvavrityanmadryagindramiyamrichyamana ||
verses.en:
The speaker filleth with a cry to Indra his ears who cometh nigh e'en from a distance.
May this my call bring Indra to my presence, this call to Gods composed in sacred verses.

verses.sa:
तं वो धिया परमया पुराजामजरमिन्द्रमभ्यनूष्यर्कैः ।
ब्रह्मा च गिरो दधिरे समस्मिन्महाँश्च स्तोमो अधि वर्धदिन्द्रे ॥
verses.rom:
tam vo dhiya paramaya purajamajaramindramabhyanushyarkaih |
brahma cha giro dadhire samasminmahanshcha stomo adhi vardhadindre ||
verses.en:
Him have I sung with my best song and praises, Indra of ancient birth and Everlasting.
For prayer and songs in him are concentrated: let laud wax mighty when addressed to Indra:

verses.sa:
वर्धाद्यं यज्ञ उत सोम इन्द्रं वर्धाद्ब्रह्म गिर उक्था च मन्म ।
वर्धाहैनमुषसो यामन्नक्तोर्वर्धान्मासाः शरदो द्याव इन्द्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
vardhadyam yajna uta soma indram vardhadbrahma gira uktha cha manma |
vardhahainamushaso yamannaktorvardhanmasah sharado dyava indram ||
verses.en:
Indra, whom sacrifice shall strengthen, Soma, and song and hymn, and praises and devotion,
Whom Dawns shall strengthen when the night departeth, Indra whom days shall strengthen, months, and autumns.

verses.sa:
एवा जज्ञानं सहसे असामि वावृधानं राधसे च श्रुताय ।
महामुग्रमवसे विप्र नूनमा विवासेम वृत्रतूर्येषु ॥
verses.rom:
eva jajnanam sahase asami vavridhanam radhase cha shrutaya |
mahamugramavase vipra nunama vivasema vritraturyeshu ||
verses.en:
Him, born for conquering might in full perfection, and waxen strongfor bounty and for glory,
Great, Powerful, will we to-day, O singer, invite to aid. us and to quell our foemen.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रस्य कवेर्दिव्यस्य वह्नेर्विप्रमन्मनो वचनस्य मध्वः ।
अपा नस्तस्य सचनस्य देवेषो युवस्व गृणते गोअग्राः ॥
verses.rom:
mandrasya kaverdivyasya vahnervipramanmano vachanasya madhvah |
apa nastasya sachanasya devesho yuvasva grinate goagrah ||
verses.en:
OF this our charming, our celestial Soma, eloquent, wise, Priest, with inspired devotion,
Of this thy close attendant, hast thou drunken. God, send the singer food with milk to grace it.

verses.sa:
अयमुशानः पर्यद्रिमुस्रा ऋतधीतिभिरृतयुग्युजानः ।
रुजदरुग्णं वि वलस्य सानुं पणीँर्वचोभिरभि योधदिन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
ayamushanah paryadrimusra ritadhitibhirritayugyujanah |
rujadarugnam vi valasya sanum paninrvachobhirabhi yodhadindrah ||
verses.en:
Craving the kine, rushing against the mountain led on by Law, with holyminded comrades,
He broke the never-broken ridge of Vala. With words of might Indra subdued the Panis.

verses.sa:
अयं द्योतयदद्युतो व्यक्तून्दोषा वस्तोः शरद इन्दुरिन्द्र ।
इमं केतुमदधुर्नू चिदह्नां शुचिजन्मन उषसश्चकार ॥
verses.rom:
ayam dyotayadadyuto vyaktundosha vastoh sharada indurindra |
imam ketumadadhurnu chidahnam shuchijanmana ushasashchakara ||
verses.en:
This Indu lighted darksome nights, O Indra, throughout the years, at morning and at evening.
Him have they stablished as the days' bright ensign. He made the Mornings to be born in splendour.

verses.sa:
अयं रोचयदरुचो रुचानोऽयं वासयद्व्यृतेन पूर्वीः ।
अयमीयत ऋतयुग्भिरश्वैः स्वर्विदा नाभिना चर्षणिप्राः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam rochayadarucho ruchano'yam vasayadvyritena purvih |
ayamiyata ritayugbhirashvaih svarvida nabhina charshaniprah ||
verses.en:
He shone and caused to shine the worlds that shone not. By Law he lighted up the host of Mornings.
He moves with Steeds yoked by eternal Order, contenting men with nave that finds the sunlight.

verses.sa:
नू गृणानो गृणते प्रत्न राजन्निषः पिन्व वसुदेयाय पूर्वीः ।
अप ओषधीरविषा वनानि गा अर्वतो नॄनृचसे रिरीहि ॥
verses.rom:
nu grinano grinate pratna rajannishah pinva vasudeyaya purvih |
apa oshadhiravisha vanani ga arvato nrinrichase ririhi ||
verses.en:
Now, praised, O Ancient King! fill thou the singer with plenteous food that he may deal forth treasures.
Give waters, herbs that have no poison, forests, and kine, and steeds, and men, to him who lauds thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र पिब तुभ्यं सुतो मदायाव स्य हरी वि मुचा सखाया ।
उत प्र गाय गण आ निषद्याथा यज्ञाय गृणते वयो धाः ॥
verses.rom:
indra piba tubhyam suto madayava sya hari vi mucha sakhaya |
uta pra gaya gana a nishadyatha yajnaya grinate vayo dhah ||
verses.en:
DRINK, Indra; juice is shed to make thee joyful: loose thy Bay Steeds and give thy friends their freedom.
Begin the song, seated in our assembly. Give strength for sacrifice to him who singeth.

verses.sa:
अस्य पिब यस्य जज्ञान इन्द्र मदाय क्रत्वे अपिबो विरप्शिन् ।
तमु ते गावो नर आपो अद्रिरिन्दुं समह्यन्पीतये समस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
asya piba yasya jajnana indra madaya kratve apibo virapshin |
tamu te gavo nara apo adririndum samahyanpitaye samasmai ||
verses.en:
Drink thou of this whereof at birth, O Indra, thou drankest, Mighty One for power and rapture.
The men, the pressing-stones, the cows, the waters have made this Soma ready for thy drinking.

verses.sa:
समिद्धे अग्नौ सुत इन्द्र सोम आ त्वा वहन्तु हरयो वहिष्ठाः ।
त्वायता मनसा जोहवीमीन्द्रा याहि सुविताय महे नः ॥
verses.rom:
samiddhe agnau suta indra soma a tva vahantu harayo vahishthah |
tvayata manasa johavimindra yahi suvitaya mahe nah ||
verses.en:
The fire is kindled, Soma pressed, O Indra: let thy Bays, best to draw, convey thee hither.
With mind devoted, Indra, I invoke thee. Come, for our great prosperity approach us.

verses.sa:
आ याहि शश्वदुशता ययाथेन्द्र महा मनसा सोमपेयम् ।
उप ब्रह्माणि शृणव इमा नोऽथा ते यज्ञस्तन्वे वयो धात् ॥
verses.rom:
a yahi shashvadushata yayathendra maha manasa somapeyam |
upa brahmani shrinava ima no'tha te yajnastanve vayo dhat ||
verses.en:
Indra, come hither: evermore thou camest through our great strong desire to drink the Soma.
Listen and hear the prayers which now we offer, and let this sacrifice increase thy vigour.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र दिवि पार्ये यदृधग्यद्वा स्वे सदने यत्र वासि ।
अतो नो यज्ञमवसे नियुत्वान्सजोषाः पाहि गिर्वणो मरुद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra divi parye yadridhagyadva sve sadane yatra vasi |
ato no yajnamavase niyutvansajoshah pahi girvano marudbhih ||
verses.en:
Mayst thou, O Indra, on the day of trial, present or absent, wheresoe'er thou dwellest,
Thence, with thy team, accordant with the Maruts, Song-lover! guard our sacrifice, to help us.

verses.sa:
अहेळमान उप याहि यज्ञं तुभ्यं पवन्त इन्दवः सुतासः ।
गावो न वज्रिन्स्वमोको अच्छेन्द्रा गहि प्रथमो यज्ञियानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ahelamana upa yahi yajnam tubhyam pavanta indavah sutasah |
gavo na vajrinsvamoko achchhendra gahi prathamo yajniyanam ||
verses.en:
COME gracious to our sacrifice, O Indra: pressed Soma-drops are purified to please thee.
As cattle seek their home, so Thunderwielder, come, Indra, first of those who claim our worship.

verses.sa:
या ते काकुत्सुकृता या वरिष्ठा यया शश्वत्पिबसि मध्व ऊर्मिम् ।
तया पाहि प्र ते अध्वर्युरस्थात्सं ते वज्रो वर्ततामिन्द्र गव्युः ॥
verses.rom:
ya te kakutsukrita ya varishtha yaya shashvatpibasi madhva urmim |
taya pahi pra te adhvaryurasthatsam te vajro vartatamindra gavyuh ||
verses.en:
With that well-formed most wide-extending palate, wherewith thou ever drinkest streams of sweetness,
Drink thou; the Adhvaryu standeth up before thee: let thy spoil-winning thunderbolt attend thee.

verses.sa:
एष द्रप्सो वृषभो विश्वरूप इन्द्राय वृष्णे समकारि सोमः ।
एतं पिब हरिव स्थातरुग्र यस्येशिषे प्रदिवि यस्ते अन्नम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha drapso vrishabho vishvarupa indraya vrishne samakari somah |
etam piba hariva sthatarugra yasyeshishe pradivi yaste annam ||
verses.en:
This drop, steer-strong and omniform, the Soma, hath been made ready for the Bull, for India.
Drink this, Lord of the Bays, thou Strong Supporter, this that is thine of old, thy food for ever.

verses.sa:
सुतः सोमो असुतादिन्द्र वस्यानयं श्रेयाञ्चिकितुषे रणाय ।
एतं तितिर्व उप याहि यज्ञं तेन विश्वास्तविषीरा पृणस्व ॥
verses.rom:
sutah somo asutadindra vasyanayam shreyanchikitushe ranaya |
etam titirva upa yahi yajnam tena vishvastavishira prinasva ||
verses.en:
Soma when pressed excels the unpressed Soma, better, for one who knows, to give him pleasure.
Come to this sacrifice of ours, O Victor replenish all thy powers with this libation.

verses.sa:
ह्वयामसि त्वेन्द्र याह्यर्वाङरं ते सोमस्तन्वे भवाति ।
शतक्रतो मादयस्वा सुतेषु प्रास्माँ अव पृतनासु प्र विक्षु ॥
verses.rom:
hvayamasi tvendra yahyarvanaram te somastanve bhavati |
shatakrato madayasva suteshu prasman ava pritanasu pra vikshu ||
verses.en:
We call on thee, O Indra: come thou hither: sufficient be the Soma for thy body.
Rejoice thee, Satakratu! in the juices guard us in wars, guard us among our people.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यस्मै पिपीषते विश्वानि विदुषे भर ।
अरंगमाय जग्मयेऽपश्चाद्दघ्वने नरे ॥
verses.rom:
pratyasmai pipishate vishvani vidushe bhara |
aramgamaya jagmaye'pashchaddaghvane nare ||
verses.en:
BRING sacrificial gifts to him, Omniscient, for he longs to drink,
The Wanderer who comes with speed, the Hero ever in the van.

verses.sa:
एमेनं प्रत्येतन सोमेभिः सोमपातमम् ।
